subject: $3 to keep fighting for Southwest Washington
body:

I’m asking you to chip in $3 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?] to help me defend one of the most competitive House seats in the country.
No, seriously. Just $3.
That’s not a typo.
I’m Marie Gluesenkamp Perez, and ever since I first won this seat in 2022, Republicans have been desperate to win it back.
They know this is one of the most competitive seats in the country – that’s why national election analysts just moved this race to "Toss-up."
They also know control of the House hinges on the outcome of our race.
That’s why the GOP is preparing to spend millions on this race.
But here's the thing: I've never had billionaire donors or Washington insiders powering my campaigns. I’ve had families, workers, and small business owners – folks who just want to believe in a better future.
I’m backed by working people chipping in what they can because they want someone in Congress who understands the challenges they're facing.
That's why your $3 matters.
* $3 helps us organize communities across Southwest Washington.
* $3 helps us reach independent and working-class voters who decide elections here.
* $3 helps us fight back against the flood of outside spending and attack ads that are already on the way.
And if enough people step up, even with just a few dollars, we'll have what it takes to win one of the closest races in the country.
So I'm asking: Can you chip in $3 right now to help us defend this seat and keep fighting for working families? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
Thank you for being part of this team.
— Marie

Jon

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Noting our progressive candidates’ astounding victories over long-term
Democratic incumbents Diana DeGette in Denver and Adriano Espaillat in New
York, the New York Times just laid out their list of which Democrats are
next on the chopping block.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260712.my-YpM&refcode=em20260712-38019&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=38019%2E1203867%2EvQHNZa ]Screenshot of a headline from the New York Times: "The Incumbent
Democrats at Risk of Losing to Progressive Challengers: A wave of outsider
fervor has already knocked out a number of incumbents in primary races.
Several more face spirited opposition."

Who’s at the very top of the list? Shri Thanedar of Michigan and Wesley
Bell of Missouri.

These two Do-Nothing Democratic incumbents are most at risk of losing
their seats to primary challengers — our very own Donavan McKinney and
Cori Bush — on August 4th.

Both Shri and Wesley are backed by AIPAC and their network of right-wing
megadonors and shell PACs, along with corporate PACs and lobby groups like
Big Tech and Big Pharma. They’re already flooding these races with
hundreds of thousands of dollars in ads and misinformation.

But they tried the same playbook in Denver and New York last month, and we
overpowered them through the power of grassroots organizing and
small-dollar donations from everyday people like YOU.

Our progressive movement’s momentum right now is undeniable. This year,
voters are showing they’re ready to replace out-of-touch career
politicians with progressive fighters who will actually put working people
ahead of powerful interests.

Now, we need to fight like hell over these final three weeks to unseat two
more establishment incumbents and send Donavan and Cori to join the rest
of our slate in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260712.my-YpM&refcode=em20260712-38019&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=38019%2E1203867%2EvQHNZa ]Let’s show everyone that our movement isn’t finished: donate

elect two more Justice Democrats!

body:
Simply put: This decision will swing more seats in the short term than the controversial mid-decade redistricting efforts that ate up so much media attention over the last year. We're watching in real-time as an entire political movement chooses the pursuit of absolute power over the fundamental rights of the people.
Please, RUSH $35 or more right now to provide the resources we need to fight for everything the Voting Rights Act stood for >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=071226_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
CNN: Efforts to game the 2026 election intensify as Republicans draw new maps [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=071226_3&amount=25]
The immediate impact shows how partisan the Louisiana v. Callais case before the Supreme Court was, Team.
In the weeks since this decision, five states have already moved to redraw their maps , dilute the impact of minority voters, and return parts of the country to a suppressive era we thought we left behind sixty years ago. Louisiana itself stopped an election with voting already in progress , and other states are moving to change their own maps soon.
CNN says this has created " an unprecedented amount of flux in American democracy six months before Election Day ." Candidates don’t know where to run. Lawmakers are seeing their districts carved up. Voters don’t know which district they live in.
This is all about power. Whether districts are fair or everyone is represented has been tossed by the wayside for MAGA's desperate grasp to control a country that's more disillusioned with their actions by the day.

Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process , is going to take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters.
Long before the MAGA movement, Chief Justice Roberts saw the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. President Trump followed this decision with a directive for conservative-led states to erase multiple majority-Black districts across the South. His supporters are climbing over one another to comply.
The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent.
The answer is to beat them at the ballot box and elect candidates who support our fundamental right to vote. Will you chip in with $35 or whatever you can to help us fight back against their desperate ploy to hold power? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=071226_3&amount=35]

Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

name: Adam Kinzinger
subject: I was there on January 6th
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117096?t=6&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD) Team,

I was there on January 6th, 2021.

I was inside the Capitol when the mob broke through. I heard the shouting in the hallways. I watched my colleagues scramble for safety.

When it was over, when the glass had been swept up and the blood had been scrubbed off the marble floors, I went back to the House floor and voted to certify the 2020 election.

And then, a few weeks later, I voted to impeach Donald Trump.

I did both of those things because I believed the truth mattered. Because I believed that what happened that day was not a protest, not a tourist visit, not a false flag: it was an attempt to overturn a free and fair election, and the people responsible needed to be held accountable.

I'm telling you all of this because I'm launching something new to fight back against Donald Trump and his attacks on our democracy, and I need you with me.

[I’m launching Back the Bold because I believe in electing Democrats who aren’t afraid to be bold and fight back against Trump. If you believe this country is worth fighting for, then I'm asking you to split $7 right away between Back the Bold and Voter Protection Project to help us hit our 10,000 Founding Donor goal »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117096?t=7&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Back the Bold PAC and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117097?t=8&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117098?t=9&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117099?t=10&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117100?t=11&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117101?t=12&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
The insurrection was five years ago.

But, team, I have spent every day and every year since watching this country get gaslit.

Watching the people who stormed those halls get pardoned and even _hired_ by Trump. Watching the officials who planned and enabled it get rewarded. Watching a man who incited a mob against his own government run for president again and win.

And I’ve questioned how we fix this broken system, how we fix our democracy, how we fight back against Trump’s blatant abuses of power.

**The best way I can think of fixing this is by electing politicians who refuse to look the other way. Period.**

That's why I'm launching Back the Bold.

We're supporting candidates who dare to stand up to MAGA extremism and hold politicians in Washington accountable. **Candidates who will say what needs to be said, do what needs to be done, and put country before politics.**

Because here's the hard truth: the only thing that stops this from happening again is a country that has a memory, and a spine, and leaders in Congress willing to use both.

We can be that country. But we have to elect people who will fight for it.
[Your donation will help us elect bold candidates who will fight back against Donald Trump. Will you split $7 today between Voter Protection Project and Back the Bold to help us hit our 10,000 Founding Donor goal? »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117096?t=13&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Back the Bold PAC and VPP will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117097?t=14&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117098?t=15&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117099?t=16&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117100?t=17&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117101?t=18&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
This is not about relitigating the past.

It's about making sure the past doesn't become the future.

Thank you,

Adam Kinzinger

I need YOUR help...The next 30 days are our chance to shape the future of South Alabama.

| | | | | | | [VIEW THIS EMAIL IN BROWSER](https://mailchi.mp/e8ddc23333b1/to-my-dad-on-fathers-day-2375645?e=3cb50a0604)

# Help us fund signs, ads, and voter outreach
# before the August 11 special primary.
---
| |
Dear Friend,
We have just 30 days left before the special primary on August 11.
That means only 30 days to reach voters across South Alabama.
Only 30 days to place signs, knock on doors, make phone calls, run ads, and tell people why this election matters.
There is no time to waste.
Today, I am asking 100 people to give $30.
Not next week.
Not someday.
**Today.**
GIVE $30 TODAY:[**https://secure.anedot.com/austin-sidwell-for-congress/donate**](https://us.list-manage.com/xIuIHnyPCcd?e=3cb50a0604&c2id=afb95f668b6ac35c1d93c48700b43452)
Your $30 will help us:• Print and place campaign signs• Run ads that reach new voters• Make calls and contact families in Alabama’s 1st Congressional District• Remind voters to show up on August 11
The political establishment may have money, influence, and powerful endorsements.
I have support from people like **YOU.**
This campaign will not be won by Washington insiders. It will be won by people across South Alabama who are ready for something different.We cannot keep sending the same people to Washington and expecting different results.
We have one chance to change that.
Will you be one of the 100 people who gives $30 today?
Every sign matters.Every ad matters.Every voter we reach matters.And every donation moves us one step closer to victory.
Thirty days.
Let’s make every one of them count.
Austin Sidwell
---
| [YES, I WILL GIVE $30 TODAY](https://us.list-manage.com/NICxQKIsI66?e=3cb50a0604&c2id=afb95f668b6ac35c1d93c48700b43452)

# About Austin Sidwell
---
| |
Austin Sidwell is a husband, father, Air Force veteran, small business leader, and conservative Republican from Alabama’s Gulf Coast. A former rescue helicopter pilot and instructor, Austin now serves as Vice President of Sidwell Protection Services and is running for Congress to bring practical leadership, fiscal discipline, and a new generation of conservative service to Washington.

| | | | | | | | | | | | **Sidwell for Congress**

**Join the Movement.****Stand Up for Alabama.** Alabama’s First Congressional District is rooted in faith, family, and country, a legacy of conservative leadership that has stood firm when it mattered most. With new lines stretching from Mobile Bay to Dothan and the Wiregrass, that calling is more important than ever. Washington is full of talkers and career politicians who’ve forgotten which side they’re on. The people of South Alabama deserve someone who will fight every single day to protect our values and put America First.

| Untitled Document
There's an indigenous group of people called the Kuna in Panama that are a fascinating story in longevity as well as stellar cardiovascular health, and lack of metabolic diseases like Diabetes, etc.

The Kuna people drink an average of 5 cups of a type of cocoa every day and they have 9x lower rates of cardiovascular problems than the rest of the world.

High blood pressure is also almost non-existent in these people, yet they actually consume a good amount of salt.

And cancer rates are an astonishing 15x lower than the rest of the world. And they don't eat much leafy green vegetables either like most Americans try to stuff down.

They also consume a fair amount of sugar, yet their arteries are clean as a whistle, and blood sugar and blood pressure are normal and healthy.

But researchers found that it's NOT their genetics, because members who moved to cities and started eating modern processed foods suffered all the same health problems as most of the world (Diabetes, obesity, heart disease, etc).

In today's article, you'll find out the Kuna's longevity secrets, and what exact type of cocoa they drink that could be a huge part of their incredible health...

> [The Kuna drink 5 cups of a type of a cacao drink daily](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MzZ9AAwAAAAAAbYwMg1Y8dNuLXuOwLqvjZ8MRHvdCgANmKjSBe8JyKiMpbY3KjTgO1TauL5lj3fsVwtti4hNQXjEx0LEIvJIVm7fqkqx5djYdpDI4Hf2) (and they have clean arteries, 9x lower heart disease rates, and healthy blood pressure and blood sugar)

This type of cacao they drink has also been shown to have up to 63x the antioxidant levels of broccoli and kale.

These particular flavanols (a type of polyphenol) in this type of cacao are shown in studies to improve heart health, lower blood pressure, boost blood flow throughout the body, improve blood sugar, and even improve your gut health by diversifying your microbiome.

Even more exciting is that the article will show you a study where cacao drinkers had nearly DOUBLE the levels of GLP-1 in their body within 2 hours of drinking cacao than people that didn't drink the cacao.

And as you know, GLP-1 in your body can help you slim down faster, so this is also a really cool benefit of drinking cacao, but strength and polyphenol levels matter as you'll see below...

[Read this article to see the type of cacao](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MzZ9AAwAAAAAAbYwMg1ZHUUSD2FFREjvHmfkV1mZXnX7kmlwugfA-rLXuzcKxHlS_pjpDxzsrwpkZdkd9vWnT_4RYTW274rq46pIvnXXCNbiSOvbZoTk) that has all of these powerful benefits. Hint: It's NOT your average grocery store cocoa.

|
Peter,
The Department of Justice just sent letters to election officials in all 50 states with a chilling threat--If a non-citizen votes, you will be personally prosecuted.
The letter also insists that state officials respond within five days to inform the justice department how it will ensure compliance "with federal laws." To avoid potential criminal charges, the DOJ "encourages" officials to contact them to "discuss steps your state should take to maintain clean voter lists as required by law."
If you've been following our work, you know that we've been sounding the alarm about the Trump admin's attempt to seize voter data. Voter data that includes sensitive information such as name, address, and party registration.
The Trump admin has been using this voter data to purge voter rolls using the "SAVE" database. A database a judge ruled was illegal because of major violations of Americans' privacy rights. And one that has been proven in court to wrongfully purge Democrats from voter rolls.
This letter isn't subtle. It's a blatant attempt to intimidate election officials into turning over your sensitive voter data.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001k-QeksNiXIzoVEtVQhBVcpE0jPdlTbXVngZApwP7fbc2e3rH4lkyIKRv0OvkQsAP7xu4DU3YqZtCpxbCoY-zN8c39WqYJT0yzb-GHSyJ5X-vtyPZK0hKWTIkxgR6JO3_Rv1-hBt2qQYon88ShibsPaIke3-L7c-yvSSMVsb2rXnXHr9XF_agY0m19lzjGHeElCTm_zRlcRuacmhzzqO9m_afWPBTlzL1gTziJ2Awzo0=&c=OtK3lX4_HiciQCjviso_MC-R9dPR2jJnyufuL7Bi72mvl8FjfyT7RQ==&ch=p7_dsg-4N4wvZRa1gzgC9aEAcI_rXjgwlvrR9qgLENXF0PYItP-zYg==)

It's yet another desperate attempt by Trump to rig the upcoming midterm elections by exerting control over how states administer elections.
The constitution is clear. States have control over how elections are administered in each respective state, not the federal government. The federal government cannot unilaterally purge voting rolls. They need states to comply with their demands. And that poses the most significant roadblock to Trump's most insidious plots to rig upcoming elections.
This is why Defend Our Courts exists. We've been leading the fight to secure Democratic majorities on state Supreme Courts across the country. The courts that will have ultimate say over election laws in respective states--a firewall against Trump's election rigging attempts.
In the past year, we helped defend the majorities on the Pennsylvania and Wisconsin state supreme courts, establishing critical firewalls in crucial swing states. In November, there are more state courts on the ballot, and we intend to bring our winning formula to those races--Nevada, Kentucky, Montana, Michigan, Minnesota.

clean_body: It’s yet another desperate attempt by Trump to rig the upcoming midterm elections by exerting control over how states administer elections. | | | | | == | Peter, The Department of Justice just sent letters to election officials in all 50 states with a chilling threat--If a non-citizen votes, you will be personally prosecuted. The letter also insists that state officials respond within five days to inform the justice department how it will ensure compliance "with federal laws." To avoid potential criminal charges, the DOJ "encourages" officials to contact them to "discuss steps your state should take to maintain clean voter lists as required by law." If you've been following our work, you know that we've been sounding the alarm about the Trump admin's attempt to seize voter data. Voter data that includes sensitive information such as name, address, and party registration. The Trump admin has been using this voter data to purge voter rolls using the "SAVE" database. A database a judge ruled was illegal because of major violations of Americans' privacy rights. And one that has been proven in court to wrongfully purge Democrats from voter rolls. This letter isn't subtle. It's a blatant attempt to intimidate election officials into turning over your sensitive voter data. | == It's yet another desperate attempt by Trump to rig the upcoming midterm elections by exerting control over how states administer elections. The constitution is clear. States have control over how elections are administered in each respective state, not the federal government. The federal government cannot unilaterally purge voting rolls. They need states to comply with their demands. And that poses the most significant roadblock to Trump's most insidious plots to rig upcoming elections. This is why Defend Our Courts exists. We've been leading the fight to secure Democratic majorities on state Supreme Courts across the country. The courts that will have ultimate say over election laws in respective states--a firewall against Trump's election rigging attempts. In the past year, we helped defend the majorities on the Pennsylvania and Wisconsin state supreme courts, establishing critical firewalls in crucial swing states. In November, there are more state courts on the ballot, and we intend to bring our winning formula to those races--Nevada, Kentucky, Montana, Michigan, Minnesota. | Friend,
---
| MAGA claims that ineligible immigrants and dead people vote all the time, always to help Democrats of course.
---
| But it turns out that there is at least one immigrant committing election fraud in America: **Elon Musk.**
---
| In 2025, Musk infamously tried to bribe voters in Wisconsin with a $1 million reward to help Republicans try to win the hotly-contested State Supreme Court race there, despite the Wisconsin AG suing to stop the giveaways as an illegal bid to buy votes.
---
| In 2024, Musk had done the same thing, except with added layers of deception: the “petition” from which prize winners were selected—titled “Petition in Favor of Free Speech and the Right to Bear Arms”—was only available to registered voters of Arizona, Georgia, Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, Nevada, or North Carolina.
---
| And now, Musk’s America PAC has been linked to a shady voter registration mass mailer rife with inaccurate info that was sent out to residents across North Carolina from a shadowy group called “Ready to Register”:
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00183SqKwDIa0heg7IxdWNJCLMR7BDMFx1_kFBnSUNljA_ssPyNy0AIS_1oL9deOMCIpqnMFiFO-AaUEP1XmRLP_eiIjDjILT5yYton7gJxcckbxA8zn8Iuyu-83hMr8_mAWzVC7pRT4nKDtdKDgaFl6JjYre3qgn-OTOoB93CCTFHW-RlgJtoc6J-x1OXAvZOBNBjFQQzsMnZj_ABAI9HtT05H-82pzReRXn27cg1xye-IR0k1CafF7fkJtbSdAlMbuevixd5rRgk=&c=AcU0AjxjOnUB92x6_ZefzSBD00tPq4iJ9wQl2iIm4Q3S8YxeO69wIQ==&ch=1QGiHl924Mn6sEm1LnC3UeUqF7aLDHKUTie-va0-XCMyHb20tVqDvw==)
---
| Incompetence is the only reason we know about the link to Musk and America PAC: according to the Washington Post, the website for Ready to Register has source code that links to America PAC, and a disclaimer for signups consenting to texts, calls, and emails from America PAC. ****
---
| One theory about the mailers is that Musk and the MAGA operatives behind Ready to Register are laying the groundwork to prompt select voters to submit incorrect information about themselves to election authorities—which could then be used as a basis to claim mass voter fraud.
---
| Ready to Register’s Facebook ads account has been running ads since late June targeting users in three swing states with enormous stakes for control of both the House and Senate: **North Carolina, Georgia and Ohio.**
---
| We have to work right now, not three months from now, to stop the Trump Administration AND evil mustache-twirling billionaires like Elon Musk from trying to rig the November midterm election.
---
| Outreach to voters will be key. **Defend Our Courts is preparing an aggressive voter protection strategy to inform voters of their rights and report problems at the polls.** We are also investing in a firewall of state courts and key judicial posts to safeguard our elections.
---
| [Musk has already spent over $250 million to elect Donald Trump and keep Republicans in power. He has only become richer since then. We are leading a grassroots resistance to the MAGA oligarchy trying to steal our democracy—can we count on you to rush an urgent donation to support our critical work today?](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00183SqKwDIa0heg7IxdWNJCLMR7BDMFx1_kFBnSUNljA_ssPyNy0AIS_1oL9deOMCIpqnMFiFO-AaUEP1XmRLP_eiIjDjILT5yYton7gJxcckbxA8zn8Iuyu-83hMr8_mAWzVC7pRT4nKDtdKDgaFl6JjYre3qgn-OTOoB93CCTFHW-RlgJtoc6J-x1OXAvZOBNBjFQQzsMnZj_ABAI9HtT05H-82pzReRXn27cg1xye-IR0k1CafF7RbxDAWZxT9U8vjdW-uZ7oA=&c=AcU0AjxjOnUB92x6_ZefzSBD00tPq4iJ9wQl2iIm4Q3S8YxeO69wIQ==&ch=1QGiHl924Mn6sEm1LnC3UeUqF7aLDHKUTie-va0-XCMyHb20tVqDvw==)

clean_body: | | | | | == | AMERICA FIRST. NAVY VETERAN. PROVEN LEADER. | Hello Peter, The August 18th election is fast approaching! Can you help us reach voters by making calls for 30 minutes this week? Please contact Alvaro (mailto:alvaro@george4congress.com) if you can help! You can call from anywhere in the United States. We appreciate your support! These are our volunteer opportunities for the week! **Good Morning!** On this day in 1930, the [first FIFA World Cup](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkEtqwzAUAE9j72T0i2UvtAgFQwvpNkvzYj3Fr8hSkJQY376kV-h-mIG5XuYLUKB4_4YNbfVpjriXgLVingNFV_C4Z1hhc4SlUIyYyz5LLnvGDRNqdkDhmHXrrEeUqFq0wgxqVEZq0652ECPnpwE1AOIynsD3vpe3UYNwgwfRkn3buBFKcG6k7gax9HgbpDHOD9pjozk6qil3P4liXdGHI70wd0va2mDXWh-lUedGTo2c9n3vbpkqxEgLvJFGTjU5OBhFtlKpKR-NnL6e4WBCMTEqzibKpbLpczqza8rBsY_no83WPXYKgUpvGs3vG1D4S9Z_fXpZ-RsAAP__iFN8tg) kicked off in Uruguay, where France's Lucien Laurent scored the tournament's first-ever goal in a 4-1 win over Mexico. ## Sen. Lindsey Graham Dies at 71
South Carolina Sen. Lindsey Graham [died Saturday night](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u7CAQBeCnwR0WP74etqC4jbtNm9LCMKwnwngFZC2_feQkb5BupNHM0Xfe7_PdUaL8eHMb2hb3OeNRE7aGZU6UQ8XzUdzqtkBYK-WMpR6zEmrkArjUc3CUznnogo2ICnWHVoLRNw1qgG614J1fzBjwnzbofHQetAcZBHoD8iY7stc3AVJLIUANvZF-xMUogBDNEJENAgO1vfQfO-W2Ykzn_sLS-33rkl1be1am_zM1MTUdx9H7pV6Ka8_UdI1MTRWza3vhvyj-o-IXi7vYsPClEEbucuD1MwTMnFLKWK_jrtjwPCglqiOwQTw2R-k7v_2ptJdVXwEAAP__g3CD8A) at 71 after what his office called a "brief and sudden illness." His top aide said there was no indication he felt unwell in his final days. The D.C. medical examiner preliminarily found he died of an [aortic dissection](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnDAQRZ_GdIP8w2J_hYs0dJs2JTJ4vExkbGR7l_D2EUneIN1II91zz_3xnJ-OIqXXd7ejbSHPCc8asTUsc6TkK16v4ja3e8JaKSUs9ZwllyNwDULN3lG85qHzNiBKVB1aoY36UloOutusf4QghtGYx2Pkq_I8rGF0ahF-NF_Gi47snca1UIJzLYfeiHXExUitfTBDQDZw9NRy6X9mSm3DEK_8wdKvee-i3Vo7KlPfmJyYnM7z7JdcW073m8np9mFyOnKkRut93jgmJ66ZnIRkcnpXqJjgny789YXNVfCEHlxoWMDBUggDuOThnfDXgWtDDxRjwlphowo5BFoRqrtuTFesP06Kkeqo2cBfu6P4p3P7r6E_Vv4OAAD__zXykzg), a rupture of the aorta, after medics responded to his Capitol Hill home for chest pains. Graham had just returned from Kyiv, where he [met with](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu9CAMwPGnSTYiYkggA8O3ZLtv7RhBMBdXhJyAXnRvX6Xt0L2bpb9k-ee323KzFCnd_9sdTQ3HkvAsEWvFvERKvuDrnu1md09YCqWEuZwLcBgZV6wXi7cUX4tsvQmIgKJF0ystJqFAqnYz_aDcOoUJRrBS2AGC1mgDTk47x4NsyVzbuOpFz7kC2el-HdFpUMoHLQM2kqOneuTu_aBUNwzxdTwxd-uxt9FstT5KI_41MDcwn-fZJbdeiqs3MD-OSJXW8mtkV25gLpjYD5J9K9nFZKpnLhMGVj68x8QoxoSlsLwmOwygANps_OOkGKmMqpH8vluKXwfVP33xaeAzAAD__669iNU) Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to push his signature Russia sanctions bill, and was booked for his 64th appearance on _Meet the Press_. President [Trump called him](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2u4yAUxfHVQJeIr3BxQTHSyF2mGmlKi5hLfEcYLCCJsvunvC289hzpV_z_XZdroEzl_ifs6EeqS8FXzzgGtiVTiR3f9xa2sEfC3qkUbP21KKHsScBJ6iUGyu_F8OgTokLN0UtwetKgDPDNr8qBwElFGwFAoktJSDDrzSW9aps4-Y8mQGopBChzdnK1eHMKICZnEjIjMNKo7fy_UhkbpvyuT2znte48-22MozP9i6mZqXm0x9h6XSnkz_8ZjWgY8u9aQo5_22M_mJqP2kdnapbSTuICk9NG2oux1vDm4_GinKlbYEbc90DfFB8_6vP06isAAP__vOF39w) "one of the greatest people and Senators I have ever known" and a "true American Patriot." Tributes poured in from both parties as a scramble began over filling his seat. Trump hinted he already has a favorite.
## US Hits Iran Again as Strait Fight Grows
The U.S. military [struck Iran again](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDtuwzAQRE8jdTT4kbVUwSKNO6dNKazIpbUJRRkkbcO3D5QrpBwMMJj3vq7zFTlxvn3iRq7Ffc70qolaozInzqHS-1ZwxS0w1co5U6mvWUs9CglCmTkgp_c89MFFIk2mJ6fAmsmAHqBf3SRlDGSn4KMxZ6nHEAPBEkGO8RwV9eyONQnKKClBDyer_EiL1QAh2iFSN0gK3PZy-t45t5Vieu9PKie_b31ya2v32pmPTl86fcH7AXBURyiNfaJOX7hgFo-K4pG5URBYcBG0ccFGVWBr6H-EhHEICrycDEi0_uyjIqsmQGvB4tIXF-4vTonrCN0gbxty-nvR_qXu6fRvAAAA___hXIKA) overnight into early this morning, its fourth round in a week, as the standoff over the Strait of Hormuz threatens to collapse peace negotiations. Sunday's strikes hit about [140 targets](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DtuxCAUQNHV4M4WvwFcUKRxN2lTWgQ_7JfwsYCMNVl9lGwhG7hXOm_39e4wYt5fXQLbQ1kzXC1C71DXiHlr8NyrO1zaEFrDnKG2a-WUq5HqkYl1cxifqxw2GwA4iAEs00bMQnOph8Mar5RhAO7GpaI80CCZN14xo-YZjB7Q_taoZoJRqrmcDPMK3g3XegtGBiCSwoa91OmjYO4HhPgsD6iTL2mI9uj9bES8EL4QvlzXNdUANU6l7oQvjvDFQ-6-pBGry2PrFT-hjUep6et7bAeeJ-Z9xLp7whchDGWzvE1HT3GodjsvjBGb0kTSPTmMf9v-L6uH5T8BAAD___fWffQ) after Iran set a container ship ablaze, leaving an Indian crew member missing. _"We bombed the hell out of them last night,"_ President Trump said. Iran retaliated with [missiles and drones](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1u4zAQhU8jdTT4t6ZcsNjGXbbdUhibQ2tiisxyJiF8-4VyhZTvB-8B39-39Q2oUH38gR2j5LZWHFxQBPtaqCbG16PDBnsiZKZasfNYrbZnpYMybk1A5bX6OcWMaNHNGE1Y3MUF68O8RWt9umuHN2eMA5_94nG5mPALzNldbnameKzpYJzROlh_Wsz9jLfFhpDy4jNOXmMiaf303qjKhrm82hf2073tc4mbyAdP7vdkr5O9jjFOQjtyy8QdsBytyV6pQ1UgAvcnq_fWE1T1_BxAotp-RDWpfyDQ1SDZVOqtIn-7OzFTOUQW7OqTFUunJ_Jkr3OP6WNQKcTnMHn92IG-H2f5EcyvaP8HAAD__1WjjEk) at five countries hosting U.S. forces (Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Jordan, and Oman), wounding three people in Qatar, including a child. Tehran insists the strait [stays closed](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHO3CAUBODT4A4LHsR4C4o07v60KS1sHvZLMKwAr-OcPtq9QtoZ6dNofn7NX44ipe2HO9C2kOeEV43YGpY5UvIV76243R2esFZKCUu9ZhAwcGG4VLN3FO9Zd94GREDVoZVmVA9lQJtut-sSlnFYHlo5WB4wqm9gjJQDAGDQq-_IvjVhpJJCGND9KNcBlxGM8WHUAZkW6Knl0v_KlNqOId75haVf89FFu7f2rEx9ZzAxmK7r6t0fyvXdMpjeNoNJGAaTlAwmKi7x2gr9xspXV7bM605PTp_UUeM58D2X4_zLPYab0sbPys_Y6HDtPLpi_fOiGKkOhmmxHY7iZ0r7r_9eFv4FAAD__8ozhSw) until calm returns. Washington says ships are still moving. Mediators are still working to save the interim deal, now at its halfway point.
## See the Declaration's Messy First Draft
Thomas Jefferson's handwritten first draft of the Declaration of Independence, complete with edits from Benjamin Franklin and John Adams, is [on display](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uhDAUhE9jOiP_CbOFizR0mzYlMrxneJGxV7a1hNtH5ArpRprRaOb7es5PT5HS9ukPdC3kOeFZI7aGZY6UoOK1Fb_7AwhrpZSw1HNWQg1cWC71DJ7iNZsOXEBUqDt00o76oa0yttsdPvQIQkuvg4YFpPWDGZRVI2AYpTcdubtNWKmlEFaZfpTrgMuorIUwmoDMCARqufTfmVLbMcQrv7H0az666PbWXpXpD6YmpqbzPPt1qfeL22dquiVTU6Sl-HLxHPia01awVo4_Oy3UePEFORQfGgdcoy--UU53lBLgCxNgWpGpqSsOXifFSHWwzIjt8BT_drR_wXs79RsAAP___AOGbA) at the Library of Congress for America's 250th birthday. The margins changed history. Jefferson first wrote that rights were "sacred and undeniable" before Franklin suggested "self-evident," and the founders swapped "subjects" for "citizens." The draft anchors more than 120 treasures, including Abraham Lincoln's handwritten Gettysburg Address and a [541⁄2-foot petition](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO6yAQgOHT4M4WjImxC4rX0OW1W1oYxvasxhABSpTbr7JX2Av8n_R_3de7J6Z0_PcX2rbnNeGrMraGZWVKseL7KP70VySslVLCUl8rSJh6aXo1rtETv1fdRbsjAo4dWmXmcRkNaNOdNkQ1TUHDtkFc9IJjmEAp9LDcTDT71pH91KRRo5LSgB5mFSbcZjAm7rPeUWiJkVouw3em1E7c-Z2fWIaQr47t2dqjivGfACfAbZyPOnAOw5GfAhznIMB9BAFOGgHOw0327cQ-YmBffKOcav8o-aKKAlxXbHy8iJnqZISWx-WJf632p0FPCz8BAAD__yh8eM4) from 3,000 South Carolinians demanding voting rights after the Civil War. Even [Kermit the Frog](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL-S2yAQxp8GdXhgQUYuKFLE3aVNqVnDStoMAg1wdpSnz9x1SXvt92_m-_18m9-QE-f1B-7k-1LmTK-WqHeqc-IcG51rxQ33yNQa50y1vWZQcJXKSW3miJzO2Q7RL0RAZiCv3WRuxoF1w-bB2hDGh9aLhgUfN7DWkNNhuo7GhIcb2H-sKaeNVsqBvUw6XOkxgXNxmexCwiqK3Eu9_Cqc-0ZLOsuT6iWUfUh-6_1ownwTcBdwx0S_McfKmPjJed1xxT-c6SMs4P5-hLJzXiU9Kff22Rm_g4BxUgLG29Q3kpFCwoqdS_7XvTV51LJzo_902YssB2XJWfZK2N4rNbliSlRPiV0KuA_Vx-PFKXG7OmHVuiOnzw_9S-CfHv4GAAD__9DNlT4) makes an appearance via Jim Henson's copyright files. Admission is free, and the exhibit runs through July 2027.

| Peter,
This campaign is going to be won by hardworking volunteers across Northwest Ohio.
With less than 130 days standing between us and another two years of Marcy Kaptur's 43-year status quo, every conversation, every phone call, and every door knocked matters.
That's why we're asking you to [join Team Merrin today](https://a6x6czhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tg7o4C9RK2l_VVxg0mxW_3U2EiSQEJGXIh0kj97B6emr7c7zZ4vuoIz-3Sdho_ecJ_dafR3kD1eijpw9-XD88byLGBuSDD8u5RhR_SWxzxgmMgvrtkWmuSfqzbtaJla8X9EkKCHqWnquPSmWs9eTACdD7pdAr79VaZWUuLkD8p4=&c=u9mDt3k64OUczmeVQ9yY6CXxn0PXzn2_w4dIgR5rD2hRjBFuvf87CA==&ch=tmUFviZ2egQVzbgUTA6KuGTmXi3b66uBbKfomg39KxYnhvWjEfAFvw==).
Whether you can give a few hours a week or a few hours a month, there's a place for you on our team. Volunteers are already helping by:

* Knocking doors in their neighborhoods
* Making phone calls to voters
* Sending text messages
* Helping at parades, fairs, and community events
* Displaying and delivering yard signs
* Recruiting friends and family to get involved

If you believe Northwest Ohio deserves new leadership, now is the time to step up.
Fill out [this form](https://a6x6czhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tg7o4C9RK2l_VVxg0mxW_3U2EiSQEJGXIh0kj97B6emr7c7zZ4vuoIz-3Sdho_ecJ_dafR3kD1eijpw9-XD88byLGBuSDD8u5RhR_SWxzxgmMgvrtkWmuSfqzbtaJla8X9EkKCHqWnquPSmWs9eTACdD7pdAr79VfXHnJcbTs8I=&c=u9mDt3k64OUczmeVQ9yY6CXxn0PXzn2_w4dIgR5rD2hRjBFuvf87CA==&ch=tmUFviZ2egQVzbgUTA6KuGTmXi3b66uBbKfomg39KxYnhvWjEfAFvw==) and a member of our team will reach out with volunteer opportunities near you.
Together, we'll build the grassroots organization needed to win this race and deliver new leadership for Northwest Ohio.
Thank you for your support.
Best, Nathanael Campaign Manager Derek Merrin for Congress

Hello, I hope your summer has been going great! Stay cool and hydrated out there.
There's a chance you've seen an ad for a reality TV show that I'm in. What's the story?
A number of months ago, I got a call that surprised me: "Hey, you've been asked to appear on a new reality TV show called 'Nation's Dumbest.' It's a fun game show like 'Are you Smarter Than a 5th Grader?' What do you think?"
I was surprised on a bunch of levels. I don't think of myself as a celebrity in the reality TV sense. I also don't think of myself as dumb. It seemed like a sharp departure from my usual activities.
But I figured it was worth a listen. I had a call with the producers during which I asked them the basic question: "Why me?"
They responded, "We are looking for a politician or journalist that people don't hate." That was kind of flattering. "It's meant to be a wholesome program for the whole family. We think you'd be great for this."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8e37a6cc-9ed1-4b66-8b01-8ff4c41806b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I got advice from different people. Some were very against me doing the show, saying it would be bad for my public image and future prospects:
"You on a billboard with the word 'Dumb' on it is not what you want."
"You're on the rise. Don't lump yourself in with a bunch of has-beens."
"You're a serious figure. Reality TV isn't serious."
But I found myself warm to the opportunity for a number of reasons.
First, it was a new experience. You only live once. When would I have the chance to do something like this again? Maybe never.
Second, I figured I'd make some new friends and connections. I was told the names of a few other figures on the show, some of whom I've been a fan of from afar for years. These included Ice-T, Anthony Michael Hall, Carmen Electra and [others](https://substack.com/redirect/6e9f5c05-8e5b-4a2a-86ab-eaaf7d167c5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It might be fun to be stuck on set with them and bond.
Third, it seemed like an opportunity to show my personality in front of a broad public audience. I do media and podcast interviews all of the time, some of which might be seen by only a few thousand people. This was a chance to get in front of millions of Americans in primetime, even if the context was a bit unusual. Maybe that would lead to more people following me and my work.
Fourth, it paid money. It was a handsome fee based on the time commitment. I agreed with Evelyn that I would donate a portion of the proceeds to an autism organization that we are involved with.
Finally, I decided to do it. I'm not someone to shy away from challenges, and it seemed like a new adventure that might lead someplace positive.
And so, I wound up a contestant on Nation's Dumbest, coming to you on Fox this Wednesday at 9 pm EST.
So . . . how did it go? What was the experience like? Did I make the right decision?
You might have to tune in to find out, as I'm kind of prohibited from sharing TOO much. But most of my reasoning was borne out; I made some new friends and definitely had a very distinct experience I won't soon forget. It could be that running for President and being on a reality TV show have more in common than you might think.
I discuss my going on "Nation's Dumbest" on the [podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/aad52e41-8e42-4666-8520-476b5f195288?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with Zach this week. body:
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. [To unsubscribe from this email list, please click here.](https://act.haleyformi.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1&akid=3509%2E49239%2EzjltHP)

[](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/24277?t=2&akid=3509%2E49239%2EzjltHP)
Hi null, it’s Gary Peters.
I’m a fifth-generation Michigander, former U.S. Navy Reservist, U.S Senator, and fighter for Michigan families – and today **I’m asking you to join me in supporting Haley Stevens for U.S. Senate.** The stakes have never been higher, null.
As the Senator who’s represented Michigan for the past 12 years, I want to share why I know Haley is the most qualified candidate to replace me in November.

**Haley loves Michigan more than anything.** She was born and raised right here in Michigan by small business owners. Raised on the value of hard work and around a lot of grease, grime, and heavy machinery. She’s a fighter and someone who will always put Michigan families first.
But experience matters: **Haley has a record of fighting and delivering for Michiganders** – from helping save 200,000 Michigan jobs on President Obama’s auto rescue task force to passing the CHIPS and Science Act to bring _even more_ jobs to Michiganders. She was even recognized as the most effective Michigan Democrat in Congress – just like I was in the Senate. She has a strong record of getting stuff done and working across the aisle to do it.
Haley will be the fighter that Michiganders deserve, and I’m proud to support her in this race.

**null, this is one of the most important races this cycle –**** _if not the MOST important._ The GOP is already flooding the state with MAGA cash to flip Michigan red and keep control of the Senate. Haley has a tough fight ahead of her. It’s never been more critical to win this race and to put an end to Trump’s dangerous agenda.**
[**So please, will you chip in $5 to Haley’s campaign to help keep Michigan blue, send MAGA Mike Rogers packing (again) and help flip the Senate for Democrats?**](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/24283?amount=5&t=3&akid=3509%2E49239%2EzjltHP)
| | [Donate](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/24278?t=4&akid=3509%2E49239%2EzjltHP)
---
Thank you,

Gary Peters
|
* * *
**A note from Haley Stevens:** null, I’m proud to be a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. That’s why I’ve fought so hard for working families my entire life. Now, I’m running for Michigan’s open Senate seat to continue fighting for the people and communities I love. The path to the Senate majority runs right through Michigan, which means this race is shaping up to be the most competitive and expensive in the entire country. The GOP is already coming after me as a top target for defeat, so I’m counting on your grassroots support to fight back and win. [**If you’re in this fight with me, will you add your name to endorse my campaign?**](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/24280?t=5&akid=3509%2E49239%2EzjltHP) | | | [](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/24279?t=6&akid=3509%2E49239%2EzjltHP)

Thank you,
Haley

Dear Peter,
For the first time ever, the Republican Party will hold a Midterm Convention -- a historic, one-of-a-kind event. President Donald J. Trump, Vice President J.D. Vance, the Republican National Committee and Republicans from around the country will come together in Dallas for a national celebration heading into the 2026 midterms -- a moment to unite our Party, energize our grassroots, and showcase our candidates on the national stage, all while celebrating our nation, our achievements, and our bright future.
"We are going to celebrate the GREAT AMERICAN COMEBACK, and the incredible successes of the American People who transformed our Country through the America First Agenda. . . . It will be a RALLY like none other!" - President Donald J. Trump
If you're even considering going, apply to join the Massachuestts delegation right away. More information below.
To Victory in November!
---
|
---
Amy Carnevale Chair, Massachusetts Republican Party
---
The Great American Comeback Midterm Convention September 9-10, 2026 | American Airlines Center | Dallas, Texas

## What We're Celebrating
* The America First Agenda: No tax on tips, no tax on overtime, no tax on Social Security, stronger borders, the safest communities in our history, lower costs, and real affordability for American families.
* More jobs, American energy dominance, and the hardworking Americans, innovators, entrepreneurs, manufacturers, first responders, and job creators powering our nation's Golden Age.
* America's 250th Birthday -- together, we are building the foundation for the next 250 years of American Greatness.

## What This Event Is
* A special ceremonial national gathering -- not a nominating convention.
* A celebration of our Party's vision and candidates, built to mobilize voters ahead of November.

## Key Distinctions from Conventions
* No nominating delegates. There is no credentialing process, as this is not a delegate or alternate event associated with a nomination.
* Tickets, not credentials. Each state party will receive and distribute a set allocation of tickets. The MassGOP will accept applications for tickets and applicants are subject to vetting at both the state and national level.

## Logistics at a Glance
* Dates: Wednesday, September 9 - Thursday, September 10, 2026
* Venue: American Airlines Center, 2500 Victory Ave, Dallas, TX 75219
* Ticket allocations: The allocation process will move quickly. There is a $20 processing fee per application.
* Dues: If selected, you must pay your dues within 48 hours, which are expected to increase from the 2024 Convention Dues of $500.
* Hotels: The MassGOP will reserve an allocation of hotel rooms for ticket holders once the official hotels are released by the RNC.
* Transportation: Transportation to and from Dallas will be on your own. Transportation to and from the RNC hotels to the American Airlines Center will be provided to all official ticket holders.
* Overall Costs: Upwards of $3,000
* Questions: Contact the MassGOP at [info@massgop.com](mailto:info@massgop.com)

body:
I’m so proud to be in this with you.

| | | | Peter,
They call us “radicals.”
They call us “extremists.”
They call us “deplorables.”
The media mocks us. The Hollywood elites look down on us. The D.C. swamp tries to break us every single day.
But when I look at you, Peter, I don’t see any of that,

I see a patriot.
I see a hero who works hard, loves their family, and stands up for what is right, even when it’s not popular.
I see someone with a spine of steel who loves this country too much to let it go. I don't say this enough, but I am so incredibly proud to be in this fight with you.

Lead Story · The Passing of a Senator
LINDSEY GRAHAM, SENATE INSTITUTION AND TRUMP ALLY, DEAD AT 71
What's Happening
South Carolina has lost its senior senator. **Sen. Lindsey Graham, R-S.C., died Saturday night at 71** after what his office called a "brief and sudden illness." Preliminary findings from the D.C. medical examiner point to an aortic dissection brought on by hardening of the arteries. A top aide said there had been no sign he was unwell.
The Life
* The **first in his family to attend college** , Graham grew up above his parents' restaurant and pool hall in Central, South Carolina
* He gave **33 years** to the Air Force, Air Force Reserve, and Air National Guard as a JAG officer, retiring a colonel in 2015
* He reached the U.S. House in 1995 and won his Senate seat in 2002, **succeeding the legendary Strom Thurmond**
* He was the last surviving member of the Senate's old guard of defense hawks, and had just won June's GOP primary for a fifth term

Working to the End
Graham never slowed down. He had just returned from Kyiv, where he met President Zelenskyy on Friday, and was booked for "Meet the Press" on Sunday. Trump says the two spoke by phone Saturday night — hours before Graham's death — and that "other than being tired, he was fine."
The Tributes
Trump ordered flags to half-staff and called Graham **"one of the greatest people and Senators I have ever known"** and "a true American Patriot." Gov. Henry McMaster called him "irreplaceable" and "the fiercest of fighters for South Carolina and America." Remembrances poured in across every line — Majority Leader John Thune, VP JD Vance, George W. Bush, Israel's Netanyahu, Ukraine's Zelenskyy, NATO's Mark Rutte, Cindy McCain mourning a fellow "Three Amigo," and even Democrats Dick Durbin and Elizabeth Warren, who had traveled alongside him overseas.
What's Next
Under South Carolina law, Gov. McMaster will name a temporary replacement to serve out the term through Jan. 3, 2027. Because Graham had already won the primary, Republicans now face a compressed sprint for the November ballot: a **filing window of July 21–28, a special primary Aug. 11** , and a runoff Aug. 25 if needed, with the winner facing Democrat Annie Andrews. What's Happening
After Iran's Revolutionary Guard again struck commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, the U.S. launched a major overnight assault and followed with more strikes Sunday evening. CENTCOM says President Trump personally directed the operations.
The Situation
* The overnight barrage hit roughly **140 Iranian military sites** — air defenses, command-and-control, coastal radar, anti-ship missiles, and more than 60 IRGC fast boats
* Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's verdict: **"Iran made a poor choice. Now they pay."**

What's Happening

# PRESS RELEASE

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
July 13, 2026

**CONTACT**
Todd Cheewing
Todd@Ascent-Strategic.com
**LILY TANG WILLIAMS ANNOUNCES "ASK ME ANYTHING" TOWN HALL SERIES, CHALLENGES MAGGIE GOODLANDER TO FACE GRANITE STATERS**
WEARE, N.H. — Republican congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams today announced the launch of her _"Ask Me Anything" Town Hall Series, _an ongoing series of open, unscripted public forums where every Granite Stater is invited to ask any question, raise any issue, and engage in a candid conversation about the future of New Hampshire and the country. Unlike carefully managed political events, there will be no pre-screened questions and no topics off-limits. The events are open to the public and the media. Williams said the town halls are intended to restore the New Hampshire tradition of accessible, accountable leadership—a stark contrast to Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander's approach. "Granite Staters deserve a representative who doesn't hide from the people she was elected to serve," said Lily Tang Williams. "While Maggie Goodlander has become known for avoiding open public forums and limiting opportunities for voters to ask tough questions, I'm doing exactly the opposite. I'll answer questions from anyone, anywhere, at any time. That's what accountability looks like." "Serving as a public official representing New Hampshire isn't about carefully scripted appearances or talking only to friendly audiences," Lily Tang Williams continued. “If you're asking all of the families in the 2nd District to trust you with another term in Congress, you should be willing to stand before them without a filter." Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.

# [Gary Peters: I'm proud to endorse Haley Stevens for U.S. Senate](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=206747058&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA2NzQ3MDU4LCJpYXQiOjE3ODM5NDk3MTUsImV4cCI6MTc4NjU0MTcxNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.pOBtpBB4ByR-8mgxDZEUg9bVVcbfk2aYabqoenz2bg0)
### The fighter Michigan needs
Jul 13
---

---
| | | [](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/gary-peters-im-proud-to-endorse-haley?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-restack-comment&action=restack-comment&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA2NzQ3MDU4LCJpYXQiOjE3ODM5NDk3MTUsImV4cCI6MTc4NjU0MTcxNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.pOBtpBB4ByR-8mgxDZEUg9bVVcbfk2aYabqoenz2bg0&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/gary-peters-im-proud-to-endorse-haley?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/889eca8e-c585-4e4f-b392-9674e7b4670d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Hi friends, it's Gary Peters.
When I chose to move on from the U.S. Senate, I did so because I have always believed that American democracy can only remain healthy and vibrant when every citizen takes an active role in strengthening their community. It was time for someone new to fight for Michigan in the U.S. Senate.
Over the last eighteen years, while serving the people of Michigan, I have been surrounded by many extremely talented and dedicated partners who work tirelessly for our state.
**Haley Stevens has been that partner in Congress.** And in many ways, my story is hers.
Haley grew up in Oakland County. Her parents met at Oakland University and her Dad became a teacher - just like my Dad. My mom was a nurse's aide and SEIU union steward. Her mom is a community leader and small business owner. Haley's story is my story: two middle-class Michigan kids working hard and giving back through public service.
Haley began her service to Michigan as a critical part of our team as President Obama and I fought to save 200,000 jobs- helping the auto industry come roaring back in Michigan.
Year after year, I have been honored to be ranked as the most effective member of the U.S. Senate for passing major pieces of legislation by working with my colleagues on both sides of the aisle. I'm proud that Haley was recognized as the most effective Michigan Democrat in Congress. She fights and delivers for Michiganders day in and day out.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/debd4e76-8074-47a9-8ed9-ef8dd2ab28e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Friends, make no mistake. Michigan is a purple state. Winning in Michigan means living up to our values and listening to our neighbors, even if we don't always agree with them. Michiganders don't like extremes. They like hard work and common sense.
When I was first elected to Congress in 2008, I always knew there would come a time to pass the torch to the next generation of public servants and allow them the opportunity to bring fresh energy and ideas to our nation's capital.
Haley Stevens will be ready on day 1 to fight for Michigan. To fight to put an end to Donald Trump's madness. And to make sure Mike Rogers doesn't come anywhere close to the U.S. Senate.
Last year, I made clear I planned to actively campaign to ensure we elect a dynamic Democratic candidate to be the next U.S. Senator from Michigan.
So that's what we're going to do starting today. **Colleen and I are excited to announce we 're all in for Haley Stevens. **_**Let 's go win.**_
Thank you friends,
Gary Peters
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/5365a4c9-5416-4704-9141-3913b5f95695?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135180753/633381234/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM3NWM3NDM2LWM1N2UtZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0rX-8NDB0sZMjEPzHcpViVWkQMkdsp82kRATrLOKDCY=&emci=d6b5e209-8c7c-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=375c7436-c57e-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=8431045)

The gutting of the Voting Rights Act by the Supreme Court. A coordinated, multi-state mid-decade redistricting crisis. Constant threats against our elections by anti-democracy forces. **Peter, our democracy is under attack.** Amid this chaos, Donald Trump and his MAGA allies have been spreading misinformation about the upcoming elections — a key part of their strategy to stay in power. The National Democratic Redistricting Committee is fighting back and helping voters separate fact from fiction. ([**Help fund this democracy-saving work →**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135180754/633381235/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_MythsFacts_email_20260713-NDRC-Tier1-MythsFacts_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260713-NDRC-Tier1-MythsFacts_&utm_campaign=MythsFacts&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM3NWM3NDM2LWM1N2UtZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0rX-8NDB0sZMjEPzHcpViVWkQMkdsp82kRATrLOKDCY=)) **So let’s take a minute to set the record straight on a few glaring myths:** **MYTH:** Democrats are exaggerating about Trump trying to rig the midterm elections. **FACT:** Trump has told us he will do everything in his power to tilt the election toward Republicans, and his actions back it up. He begged Texas and other states to redraw their maps mid-decade to gain an advantage. He called for Republicans to “take over the elections” and is insisting on passing the SAVE Act to “guarantee the midterms.” **MYTH:** “The cheating on mail-in voting is legendary.” **FACT:** There is no evidence to support Donald Trump’s claim of mass election fraud in any area — and that includes vote-by-mail. The president knows this, of course — he relies on casting his ballot in the mail, and even did so earlier this year. **MYTH:** Taking a longer time to call the outcome of an election, like in California’s June 2nd primary, is evidence that there was election fraud. **FACT:** The majority of Californians vote by mail, and a ton of these people opt to hand-deliver their ballots on Election Day. Under current law, these ballots can’t be counted until the polls have closed. As much as it tries our patience, no one has ever found a shred of evidence of meaningful levels of fraud. **If there’s one thing we’ve learned from going up against the president’s misinformation for years now, it’s this: Getting out the truth requires people power. ** **It’s not going to be easy, but we have what it takes to defeat these attacks on our elections.[Make a gift today to help harness the strength of this community to defend democracy from Trump and his anti-democracy goons >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135180755/633381236/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_MythsFacts_email_20260713-NDRC-Tier1-MythsFacts_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260713-NDRC-Tier1-MythsFacts_&utm_campaign=MythsFacts&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM3NWM3NDM2LWM1N2UtZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0rX-8NDB0sZMjEPzHcpViVWkQMkdsp82kRATrLOKDCY=)** Thank you, National Democratic Redistricting Committee | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135180756/633381237/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_MythsFacts_email_20260713-NDRC-Tier1-MythsFacts_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260713-NDRC-Tier1-MythsFacts_&utm_campaign=MythsFacts&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM3NWM3NDM2LWM1N2UtZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0rX-8NDB0sZMjEPzHcpViVWkQMkdsp82kRATrLOKDCY=)

clean_body: Let’s harness the strength of this community to defend democracy | The gutting of the Voting Rights Act by the Supreme Court. A coordinated, multi-state mid-decade redistricting crisis. Constant threats against our elections by anti-democracy forces. Peter, our democracy is under attack. Amid this chaos, Donald Trump and his MAGA allies have been spreading misinformation about the upcoming elections — a key part of their strategy to stay in power. The National Democratic Redistricting Committee is fighting back and helping voters separate fact from fiction. (=) So let’s take a minute to set the record straight on a few glaring myths: MYTH: Democrats are exaggerating about Trump trying to rig the midterm elections. FACT: Trump has told us he will do everything in his power to tilt the election toward Republicans, and his actions back it up. He begged Texas and other states to redraw their maps mid-decade to gain an advantage. He called for Republicans to “take over the elections” and is insisting on passing the SAVE Act to “guarantee the midterms.” MYTH: “The cheating on mail-in voting is legendary.” FACT: There is no evidence to support Donald Trump’s claim of mass election fraud in any area — and that includes vote-by-mail. The president knows this, of course — he relies on casting his ballot in the mail, and even did so earlier this year. MYTH: Taking a longer time to call the outcome of an election, like in California’s June 2nd primary, is evidence that there was election fraud. FACT: The majority of Californians vote by mail, and a ton of these people opt to hand-deliver their ballots on Election Day. Under current law, these ballots can’t be counted until the polls have closed. As much as it tries our patience, no one has ever found a shred of evidence of meaningful levels of fraud. If there’s one thing we’ve learned from going up against the president’s misinformation for years now, it’s this: Getting out the truth requires people power. It’s not going to be easy, but we have what it takes to defeat these attacks on our elections.= Thank you, National Democratic Redistricting Committee | = = | | Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President. | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|---|--- National Democratic Redistricting Committee 712 H St NE, #25 Washington, DC 20002 United States if you'd like to receive fewer emails from the NDRC. body:
National GOP insiders are panicking and scrambling to respond to the threat Sean and this grassroots campaign pose.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135181832/633384993/510768709?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTIzMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MDkyYjA5YS1jNzdlLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qEU8WqT_dcn1xGX39KOWxWijhOUOVicng6buO-mvmos=) **A lot has happened in the race to flip MI-04, so we wanted to give you three major updates:** **First,** a new poll shows Sean McCann leading Bill Huizenga by 3 points. _This is a major sign that the race is moving in our direction and that voters across Southwest Michigan are ready for new leadership._ **Second,** Huizenga recently scrubbed his campaign website of extreme positions on abortion, healthcare, and immigration. That tells us he knows his record is out of step with this district. subject: Election Integrity Workers Needed! DEADLINE WEDNESDAY
body:
Election Integrity Workers Needed! DEADLINE WEDNESDAY

| | | | | | |
Good Day, INSPECTOR OF ELECTION APPOINTMENT DEADLINE IS THIS WEDNESDAY.
Free and fair elections don’t happen on their own; they happen because of hard-working people like you who show up. Last cycle, a lot of Republicans served our state as a Poll Challenger and/or Inspector of Elections, and the integrity of our polling was stronger because of it.
Another election is coming, and the Republican Party is counting on your help. Poll Challengers safeguard transparency by monitoring compliance with election laws while protecting voters’ rights and keeping order. Inspectors of the Election work for the moderator and keep Election Day running fairly and accurately, verifying checklists, processing voters, and handling ballots in accordance with New Hampshire law. Both roles are essential, and people like you are the backbone of the effort.
Training will be set up for both Inspectors of the Election and Poll Challengers.
We’d be grateful to have you serve. Reply to nhelectionintegrity@nhrsc.com and we’ll send over details on how to get you signed up.
Let’s make sure this election is handled right. We hope you’ll join uS.
For additional information, see the job descriptions below.
Best,
Scott MaltzieChairman New Hampshire Republican State Party
### Poll Challenger
A Poll Challenger is a designated representative of a political party or candidate who observes the voting process and may raise concerns regarding a voter's eligibility when there is a legitimate basis to do so. Poll Challengers help promote transparency and confidence in elections by monitoring compliance with election laws while respecting voters' rights and maintaining order at the polling place.
### Inspector of Elections
An Inspector of Elections is an election official appointed to assist in the administration of Election Day operations. Inspectors help verify voter checklists, process voters, maintain accurate election records, assist with ballot handling, and ensure election procedures are conducted fairly, accurately, and in accordance with New Hampshire law. They serve as part of the team responsible for the integrity and smooth operation of the polling place.Both roles need to participate in a training session and require an appointment letter from the Chairman of the State Party.Sincerely,

Scott MaltzieChairman

# [Link updated](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/07/13/link-updated/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on July 13, 2026
---
| Dear Subscriber,
---
Yesterday, I was made aware that a particular link was not working on my newsletter. It was for this post in particular:
---
In the past several months, over 8 thousand PA-13 constituents have dropped their Pennie (Affordable Care Act) insurance and most have not picked up an alternative one.
---
Why?
---
Because, “Pennie claimed that several have said the decision to keep or drop their coverage is not a matter of choosing a different plan, but choosing between coverage and affording food, rent, and utilities.”
---
That’s right, because the cost of living is rising too, so there’s nowhere else to fund the higher cost of healthcare from the household budget.
---
Why else?
---
Because our own US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, voted for the One Big Beautiful Bill Act that removed the COVID era subsidies that once made Pennie affordable.
---
But we don’t have to put up with this nonsense.
---
Ultra-wealthy people can pay their fair share in taxes so Everyday Americans can have the dignity of their healthcare needs being met.
---
I, Beth Farnham, will vote in the US House of Representatives, along with other caring legislators for a national healthcare plan that provides healthcare for All.
---
Please vote for me in November because when you choose Beth Farnham, you[ #ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=b8fad2cbe8982af6b4f9185a1cbfd3ccdbdecc376f0a2af65f7db625121a224d&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8217&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=fcfc83f17205d8e7792723808cd74297&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=3cfbec87c23251edc6876a4708425e5e) and the good health of our neighbors.
---

Beth
