# Boise isn't safe
### And the Governor can fix it today
| | | [Brian Lenney](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
| Jul 13
---
| [](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
Boise isn't safe anymore...
_**Because the people in charge of protecting the city (Mayor Lauren McLean and the Boise Police Department), won 't.**_
Recently, a 25-year-old man was riding his scooter home along the Greenbelt. He was ambushed and stabbed to death and the homeless man who killed him sleeps on that same Greenbelt (the prosecutor said so in open court).
Everybody knew about him, and nothing was done.
In 2025, we passed a law meant to stop exactly this: cities the size of Boise are barred from letting people camp on public land, and the law lets the attorney general take a city to court if it refuses to comply.
Mayor McLean fought that law the whole way. She said it was "not the solution." Her exact words: "Criminalizing homelessness has never, and will never, solve the problems associated with homelessness."
_So the camps stayed._
_The city did the bare minimum._
_And now an innocent man is dead._
Governor Little, you sent the National Guard to the Texas border. Where are they now? Boise is your own backyard, and it's overrun with homeless vagrants and a mayor and police department who refuse to enforce the law and refuse to protect the people who live here.
_**Send the Guard.**_
_**Clear the Greenbelt.**_
_**Protect Idahoans.**_
Or is a deployment only worth it when there's a camera at the border?
**P.S.** Call Governor Little's office at 208-334-2100. Tell them you want the state to enforce the 2025 camping law against Boise and protect people on the Greenbelt (or, [send a message through the official form](https://substack.com/redirect/e4e4ddc3-fcb0-4e47-8378-f245709650d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
**P.P.S.** Read what happened [here](https://substack.com/redirect/861be081-aad9-4869-a732-b30a0782dc7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

**Why Patients Need Trump’s Great Healthcare Plan** By Bobby Jindal and Hannah Anderson
---
It’s your dollar. This year, American families will spend more than $37,000 on private health care, while the average family on Obamacare will spend about $27,000. The per-person cost of health care in America? Nearly $16,000 for every man, woman and child. That’s $5 trillion of the American economy. Yet most Americans could not tell you where even one of those health dollars went. That cost—and the mystery of where those dollars go—is the result of two decades of putting patients last. Policymakers have handed control to bureaucrats and middlemen who choose where and how you spend your health care dollars. The result of this patients-last policy has been to turn every health dollar into a health _insurance_ dollar. Health insurance, a tool created for emergencies, is now covering primary care and generic drugs—and doing all of it badly. How bad is it? Your health insurance—designed as a financial tool to protect you from catastrophic loss—is now being used to finance a $140 doctor’s office visit or a $3 generic prescription. Consider a healthy American patient with very good insurance. She pays $200 a month in personal premiums (not counting employer contributions in lieu of compensation) and still must meet a $1,600 deductible before her coverage kicks in. She goes to the dermatologist and thinks the visit costs $140. In fact, that routine visit costs her $2,640. She used her health insurance to finance a purchase that would have been cheaper even on a high-interest credit card. [**Finish reading at Newsweek.com**](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=29f22141cdb148d0bef797cb2c9bf35c&_e=HxpcuGr78wJV8OoGM_rpoZJGZHvHcc3EqwDi6J1vCEyz8TNVpPBszs4S-GBZZPo2E2FI6_modrTUajHFBHaVEueP3dDRZEb6P2XYsFFG-_askJ_Qcf1lmVUeBsf5UE1Fhj-_aPAlQFZ0Wv2Ow_9OGOdAVn2QTTL0Bp9FadHbOY6HfL-bgSJzfc2AiwC-Z-OM1Uxib_cROfRkHTVVceFklll9dF6YiKA6A93_cjwwOvQ_523q5kteLI1JytbMuStQMHYVGV3UE74TRxE-63TVuaydNo86eC42SX1hIX_0TMft75Vj5I-OdfK-h-gbuzSf4hlVC_8Dtj5w3NRXhadrw9npvG1CounIiRa3N7cRyZ_qENdf_APUI5D5BVviarRhfk_TsUFkhcz5JCSgyaxL7nVAdQpjhEZd8Im9oN44o3F3CwPfegYjhuUyEN8QJC7Y47gzzePkhiWzWiltJpQtvCiO-F6gtcQBmoEwRkG-L-4%3D)

All I can say is, WHAT A NIGHT OF WORSHIP. For those of us gathered together in the historic Ryman Auditorium, we didn't want the night to end. 3+ hours of worship in the blink of an eye. To be so satisfied in His presence, yet longing for more — it's been a hallmark of Let Us Worship for our 6-year history. And last night we saw it again! I had to share just a short clip from the night. I hope you are encouraged and built up on this Monday!

body:
Judicial Watch announced today that the Washington, DC, Metropolitan Police Department released over 1,000 hours of body-worn camera footage in 1,627 videos from the January 6, 2021, U.S. Capitol event. The videos were released because of an April 2026 court ruling in a DC Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit.

name: Faiz Shakir, More Perfect Union
subject: [take action] As AI changes our society, let’s make sure working people don’t get left behind.
body:
[1]LeftNet

AI technology, from Sam Altman’s OpenAI to Elon Musk’s xAI, is being
developed on the collective work of generations of ordinary citizens –
musicians, journalists, artists, writers, teachers, and scientists.

These tools are already changing the way the world operates and will
continue to do so at an increasingly rapid pace. And because AI has been
built on our collective work and intelligence, it should not belong to
Silicon Valley and Wall Street billionaires. It should belong to all of
us.

Now, Sen. Bernie Sanders has introduced the American A.I. Sovereign Wealth
Fund Act to give the American people direct ownership in the largest AI
companies in the United States.

As Bernie says, “Since A.I. is built on the collective knowledge of
humanity, the wealth it generates must benefit humanity.”

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/22902?t=1001&akid=1681%2E2118727%2E8_MBOq ]Take action now. Sign our petition to urge your senators to pass
Senator Sanders’s bill to ensure the American people have a direct role in
determining the future of AI and in reaping its financial benefits.

ADD YOUR NAME ››

Senator Sanders’s bill proposes establishing a sovereign wealth fund that
would distribute wealth generated by AI back to the American people. This
would be similar to Alaska’s sovereign wealth fund that pays annual
dividends to Alaskans from the state’s oil revenues.

Norway similarly has a sovereign wealth fund worth over $2 trillion that’s
funded by the nation’s oil wealth.

And, while Bernie Sanders is championing the legislation in Congress, the
idea itself comes from the founders of AI.

Open AI has proposed a “public wealth fund that provides every citizen –
including those not invested in financial markets – with a stake in
A.I.-driven economic growth.”

Anthropic has proposed “national sovereign wealth funds with stakes in
A.I.”

Even Elon Musk who owns xAI said, “Universal HIGH INCOME via checks issued
by the Federal government is the best way to deal with unemployment caused
by AI.”

Their words are empty and meaningless until we assert some leverage over
them. An AI sovereign wealth fund could ensure a basic standard of living
for all Americans including health care, education, and housing.

As Senator Sanders wrote in a recent op-ed:

“When a public resource generates wealth, the public should share in that
wealth.”

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/22902?t=1002&akid=1681%2E2118727%2E8_MBOq ]Sign our petition to tell your senators to support and pass Bernie
Sanders’s American A.I. Sovereign Wealth Fund Act and ensure we all have a
stake in the future of AI.

AI is already changing the world. Let’s make sure working people don’t get
left behind.

In solidarity,

-Faiz

Faiz Shakir, Co-Founder
More Perfect Union

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/22902?t=1003&akid=1681%2E2118727%2E8_MBOq ]ADD YOUR NAME ››

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.leftnet.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=1681%2E2118727%2E8_MBOq

body:

---
| |
# We must reject socialism and fight for American values
---
| Dear Friend,

Right now, socialism is rearing its ugly head across the country and gaining ground for the first time in a generation. We must reject this extreme anti-American movement before it takes root in Washington and destroys the very values that have made America great. I am sure you saw that in recent weeks, self-described "Socialists" have scored alarming primary victories in places like New York, Colorado, and beyond. They aren't even hiding it anymore— these extremists are affiliated with the radical group "Democratic Socialists of America" and advocate for government control of our economy, massive tax hikes on working people, open borders, closing down prisons, defunding the police, and policies that punish success while promising "free" everything – paid for by you.

First radical Socialist Zohran Mamdani took over the once great New York City. Now, his acolytes are flipping seats around the country and spreading their dangerous ideology. Just take a look at some of the positions these socialists hold:

Melat Kiros, Socialist Nominee for Colorado's 1st Congressional District said 9-11 was _“inevitable in the sense that we destabilized a lot of the Middle East — that forced people to believe that another act of violence was the only response.”_

Darializa Avila Chevalier, Socialist Nominee for New York's 13th Congressional District said _“A world without borders—just like a world without prisons or police—is possible, necessary, and the only moral way forward.”_ These are the candidates who are in the process of swiftly taking over the Democrat Party.

The socialists don't mince words with where they stand, so neither will I. Here is what I know to be true:
* Socialism is a dangerous ideology that has failed everywhere it has been tried.
* Socialism is responsible for the death of tens of millions people who suffered, starved, and died under its repressive thumb.
* Socialism is antithetical to the values that built America into the strongest economy and most prosperous nation the world has ever seen.

_**We will never let America become socialist nation.**_ In Congress, I fight for lower taxes, less regulation, and opportunity so families can thrive. Our district fuels America with agriculture and energy, born from the hard work and industriousness of many generations of Central Valley residents. We are fighting for secure borders, safe communities, and support for our police – because the rule of law is worth protecting.

_**I believe in unity, hard work, and the principles that built this nation – not dividing us by class or pitting Americans against each other.**_ The choice is clear: We can embrace freedom, personal responsibility, and limited government – or watch socialism erode our prosperity, just as it's failing in deep-blue cities and states.

The radical left is energized by these Socialist wins. We cannot afford to sit on the sidelines. Your contribution today will help us counter their momentum and win the battles ahead. Let's keep America the land of opportunity! With your support, we'll reject socialism, restore common sense, and deliver results for California and the Country. Thank you for standing with me. Sincerely

Congressman Vince Fong

name: Courier Newsroom
subject: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo
body:
[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1005&refcode=20260713_ICE&akid=150%2E344797%2Edrm69z ]COURIER Newsroom

Peter,

On July 7, an ICE agent shot and killed Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, a
52-year-old father of three, as he drove his construction crew to work in
Houston. He wasn't even the man ICE was looking for. The acting director
of ICE has admitted it.

DHS says Lorenzo "weaponized" his vehicle. The three men in the van,
including his own brother, say that never happened. His son Ronaldo says
the agents never identified themselves. And the agents wore no body
cameras, even after Congress gave DHS $20 million for them.

If that excuse sounds familiar, it should. It's the same line DHS used
after an ICE agent fatally shot Renee Good in Minneapolis.

While the rest of the media moved on, COURIER didn't. We've been covering
ICE abuses for months, and we're telling this latest tragedy everywhere we
publish:

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/514?t=1003&refcode=20260713_ICE&akid=150%2E344797%2Edrm69z ][IMG]

On social media, where our coverage reaches millions of Americans who only
get their news in online spaces like TikTok and Instagram.

In our Substacks, where writers like Melissa Ryan are fearless demanding
accountability for ICE's abuses.

And in our Courier Texas newsroom, on the ground sharing Ronaldo Salgado's
account and the community's fight for answers, in a state where local news
is disappearing.

This is the work: staying on the story until ICE is held accountable. It's
only possible because readers fund it.

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/514?t=1004&refcode=20260713_ICE&akid=150%2E344797%2Edrm69z ]Chip in any amount to fund COURIER's coverage and help hold ICE
accountable.

In solidarity,

Hi, it’s Dr. Jasmine Clark.
First, thank you. This campaign is stronger than ever – and it’s all thanks to grassroots supporters like you. I can't tell you how much that means to me.
Right now, the average contribution to our campaign is just $26.
That means this campaign isn't powered by a handful of wealthy donors—it's powered by thousands of people chipping in what they can because they believe we deserve leaders who put science, facts, and working families first.
As a microbiologist, I've spent my career following the evidence, solving problems, and working to improve people's lives. That's the same approach I've brought to serving Georgia families in the state legislature, and it's the kind of leadership I want to bring to Congress.
This campaign has always been about people, not special interests. And that's reflected in the incredible grassroots support we've built together.
If you're able, will you join the average grassroots supporter by making a $26 contribution today? Every dollar helps us reach more voters, expand our organizing efforts, and build the campaign we'll need to win this competitive race. I've included the contribution link here for your convenience: secure.actblue.com/jc-xz-260713 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]
The months ahead will determine the future of this race, and every conversation we have with voters matters. Your support today helps us keep growing this movement and ensures we have the resources to compete every step of the way.
Thank you for believing in this campaign and for being part of this grassroots team.
Together, we can build a future grounded in facts, opportunity, and leadership that works for everyone.
Dr. Jasmine Clark

# [Nebraska shocks experts by ranking among America's best states for 2026](https://substack.com/redirect/dbd913ee-ec80-4cf1-9f2e-228ccc0def8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**CNBC increased the weight of the quality of life category** to 11.6% in its America's Top States for Business study **[as companies prioritize attractive living locations to attract talent amid return-to-office mandates.](https://substack.com/redirect/568a176e-ab41-4b07-81d0-37497c3633f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

* **Quality of life gains weight** : The category now makes up 11.6% of a state's overall score up from about 10% last year using hard data on crime rates air quality healthcare childcare inclusiveness and reproductive rights.
* **Nebraska excels in health** : The state has the fewest drug deaths per capita at 8.7 per 100000 people thanks to its extensive prescription drug monitoring program reporting every prescription and exceptionally clean air.
* **Massachusetts leads healthcare** : It has more primary care physicians per capita and the smallest percentage of people without health insurance thanks to Romneycare reforms with 53.4% of residents reporting good or excellent health.

# [Red States crash as CNBC re-weights it's business index to include "quality of life" indicators](https://substack.com/redirect/dbd913ee-ec80-4cf1-9f2e-228ccc0def8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dbd913ee-ec80-4cf1-9f2e-228ccc0def8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

OpenAI president Greg Brockman has **[taken full oversight of the company's key product and business operations](https://substack.com/redirect/8bc6df1c-a8cd-419f-aa5f-20c79c135ee8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after Fidji Simo stepped down due to chronic illness, solidifying his role as second-in-command ahead of the firm's prospective IPO.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dbd913ee-ec80-4cf1-9f2e-228ccc0def8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Product duties now expand** : Brockman will oversee ChatGPT product business, go-to-market teams, enterprise teams and compute initiatives while reporting directly to CEO Sam Altman.
* **Fidji Simo steps down** : Former Meta executive served about one year as product and business chief before transitioning to part-time advisor after medical leave for postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome.
* **Valuation pressure intensifies** : OpenAI holds an $852 billion dollar valuation after confidentially filing its prospectus in June amid stiff competition and ChatGPT market share falling below 50%.
* **No successor hired** : Finance chief Sarah Friar and strategy chief Jason Kwon will report to Altman with the company not planning to hire anyone to replace Simo.

# [Apple explodes on OpenAI with massive trade secret theft lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/dbd913ee-ec80-4cf1-9f2e-228ccc0def8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Apple **[filed a federal lawsuit against OpenAI](https://substack.com/redirect/61dd9fa5-9e76-4edf-9b46-9d0e8cdee97c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in Northern California accusing the AI company of stealing trade secrets at every level to develop its own consumer hardware, marking a reversal from their 2024 partnership integrating ChatGPT into iPhones.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dbd913ee-ec80-4cf1-9f2e-228ccc0def8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Former employees implicated** : OpenAI hardware chief Tang Tan, a former Apple vice president, directed job candidates to bring actual Apple parts for show and tell interviews to extract confidential information.
* **Theft claims detailed** : Chang Liu allegedly stole an Apple laptop while OpenAI coached departing employees on evading security processes when leaving the iPhone maker.
* **Technique misappropriated** : OpenAI asked hardware firms to use an Apple invented metal finishing process while misleading partners into believing they had permission.
* **Partnership chilled** : Apple shifted its upcoming Siri assistant to Google Gemini models instead of OpenAI technology after OpenAI bought Jony Ive startup IO Products for $6.4 billion dollars.

# [Tech elites quit and retire early to dodge brutal AI workplace takeover](https://substack.com/redirect/dbd913ee-ec80-4cf1-9f2e-228ccc0def8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
More technology professionals like **[are retiring earlier than planned](https://substack.com/redirect/04c020e2-0a8e-4fea-8dc7-0d9399049146?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** rather than adapt to AI becoming the sole focus at companies such as Microsoft subsidiary GitHub.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dbd913ee-ec80-4cf1-9f2e-228ccc0def8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Personal reasons pile up** : 60-year-old Jennifer Kerns cited leadership departures, her child aging out of insurance and AI focus she views as an overblown bubble that offends her creative sensibilities.
* **Decision not fear based** : The longtime program manager with over 30 years in tech did not want to learn or use the technology at this stage of her career.
* **Industry revolution drives exits** : Retirement experts note workplace changes from the AI shift in tech push end-of-career employees toward early retirement.
* **Statistics show trend** : An Allianz Life study found 42% of Americans retire earlier than intended with workplace changes among the top drivers.

SLIC cofounder Michael Gottlieb, a Florida state legislator, and Sen. John Fetterman. Photo: Instagram.
On June 2, politicians from around America, including Trump administration official Leo Terrell, met at the Israeli embassy in Washington, D.C. for a glitzy reception. The next day, they met Sen. John Fetterman (D-Pa.) in his office. The event celebrated the launch of a little-known nonprofit--the State Legislator Israel Caucus.
Little public information exists about SLIC, which grew out of an earlier Israeli government-funded junket for American politicians. The group's[ website](https://substack.com/redirect/26915ec6-1f1a-47ba-9b8a-f700f7fedbbe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has only a basic contact form, and its nonprofit registration has not yet appeared in the[ official database](https://substack.com/redirect/73c9605e-5164-44bc-8edd-f2602bd9a3f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which usually takes a few months. The June 2 event was not reported anywhere except for a[ Facebook post](https://substack.com/redirect/3caf267f-1f3b-478c-a63a-a29186a462ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (and[ identical Instagram post](https://substack.com/redirect/d2b02cd9-3dfe-40ad-b1e6-a7a2949b4685?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) by SLIC cofounder Michael Gottlieb, a Democratic state legislator in Florida.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/d71d3a0a-106e-438e-b803-f201e43978bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
[](https://substack.com/redirect/d9739fb4-3e48-4e9d-a558-b67a3085a98f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Instagram
[View on Instagram](https://substack.com/redirect/d9739fb4-3e48-4e9d-a558-b67a3085a98f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Documents obtained by Drop Site News under the Florida Sunshine Law outline SLIC's aims: to set up a system to distribute pro-Israel "model legislation" to state lawmakers around the country. When reached by phone, Gottlieb insisted that the organization was entirely his own initiative, though he acknowledged that the Israeli government funded the launch event.
SLIC is maintaining a Dropbox account to share language for bills, according to the [launch event invitation](https://substack.com/redirect/dc2c5dcb-dd4d-4fb8-8380-4da41d13a449?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) obtained under the Florida Sunshine Law. The linked account is not available for members of the public to view.
"I believe I'm the only person who has contributed so far," Gottlieb said, referring to the draft legislation his organization is pitching lawmakers. Gottlieb mentioned two specific examples of future proposals he had in mind: "Some states have had Shari'a law bans, so somebody could put that there if they wanted, and there are Judea and Samaria bills."
Earlier this year, Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis[ signed a bill](https://substack.com/redirect/f3c8fdce-ff23-43f0-8e16-9feb8b252035?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against applying Islamic law in Florida, stating that "we shouldn't have people in this country that hate this country." The state legislature is currently[ considering a bill](https://substack.com/redirect/2185aa1d-b847-400c-a662-41da03ec18d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to ban calling the West Bank by anything other than the Israeli nationalist term "Judea and Samaria," which Gottlieb insists is the correct name.
"Anybody could contribute anything to it," Gottlieb added, referring to the Dropbox account. "It wouldn't necessarily have to be Israel-focused or Jewish-focused or antisemitism-focused. You could put it in there for anybody to see."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZHJvcHNpdGVuZXdzLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.UC4TF9V0F3lzcNHOtPZ690XlfGRjgUjY9fb4bdHFIpg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=206462157)
Gottlieb's Facebook post claims that 75 lawmakers from 35 states have joined SLIC so far, and the launch event invitation promises to release a directory, with the option for members to remain anonymous due to "antisemitism and doxxing issues." Emily Gise, a Republican state legislator from Oklahoma, is listed as vice chair on the invitation. Jeremy England, a Republican state legislator from Mississippi, is listed as treasurer. Neither responded to requests for comment. As a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, the invitation explains, "SLIC will not as an organization take a role in lobbying for candidates or legislation, instead we will serve as a vault so that members can access this information and utilize it for their states, as they deem appropriate."
The U.S. tax code limits the political lobbying that 501(c)(3) organizations can engage in. While nonprofits are[ absolutely forbidden](https://substack.com/redirect/c42b33d9-53a6-468d-9aef-701b723fa4f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from campaigning in elections, they are allowed to attempt "to influence legislation" by contacting lawmakers, as long as it is not a "[substantial](https://substack.com/redirect/2a9419ba-f2eb-4943-99fe-b97d2f23aabd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" part of their activities, according to the Internal Revenue Service. However, the IRS gives nonprofits wide latitude to "educate" the public about specific issues without it counting as lobbying.
Asked about his relationship with the Israeli government, Gottlieb responded, "My relationship with the government? That makes it seem kind of sordid." SLIC grew out of[ 50 States One Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/b55ed4b2-3c92-432a-8162-21996db07f1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), he said--a 2015 initiative in which the Israeli foreign ministry[ paid for](https://substack.com/redirect/5f5ed89e-f537-4aa2-a4a7-e584f006bb92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 250 state-level politicians from the U.S. to tour the country and meet with Israeli officials. (An off-key performance of "[Somewhere Over the Rainbow](https://substack.com/redirect/18fcd562-4b0b-48e3-8f37-e22abfe89743?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" from the conference went viral.) As a participant in the tour, Gottlieb stated that he was inspired to bring together friends of Israel from both sides of the aisle.
"At the incredible rate we have been building and the level of acceptance of our organization by the Israeli, government, [sic] we are hopeful that this organization will become a formidable partner for legislators in establishing model legislation," Gottlieb wrote in an[ invitation](https://substack.com/redirect/be1360a9-4730-4197-baf5-c57f277e9b10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the SLIC launch, released under the Florida Sunshine Law.
Israeli Ambassador Michael Leiter attended the launch alongside "many other Israeli diplomates [sic]," Gottlieb wrote on Facebook. Fetterman and Terrell, an attorney in the Justice Department's civil rights division, also met with SLIC members.
The Israeli embassy in Washington did not respond to a request for comment.
At a time when a majority of Democrats have[ turned](https://substack.com/redirect/baec0af8-3dbb-4a59-8bbc-a90ea65c7511?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against the U.S.-Israeli relationship, Fetterman has become a[ loud and proud voice](https://substack.com/redirect/0a7fe269-09be-4cfb-bd27-2f7f8cadadd1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for Israel. And in private, Fetterman has strategized with Leiter on pushing a pro-Israel agenda in Congress; taken long phone calls with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu; and taken on David Safier, a self-described friend of one of Netanyahu's advisors, as his own personal confidante, according to a[ recent report](https://substack.com/redirect/ebfa722e-2101-4661-8dfd-70d3b7fb7ee8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in New York Magazine.
Terrell, meanwhile, has led the Trump administration's[ crackdown](https://substack.com/redirect/2afe4958-fd81-47fe-9620-6677ae015d7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on pro-Palestine student activism, promising to "[bankrupt](https://substack.com/redirect/23725c8a-c898-4582-b96c-9402dee91acb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" universities. He[ recently told](https://substack.com/redirect/23725c8a-c898-4582-b96c-9402dee91acb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Jerusalem Post that his goals include expanding the crackdown to elementary and high schools, and deploying "rapid response teams" in "blue cities." In January 2026, the Israeli government[ granted Terrell](https://substack.com/redirect/cbcdc918-907b-4ae4-a91d-a24f1082cc6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its "Award of Honor for the Fight Against Antisemitism" during his[ first-ever trip](https://substack.com/redirect/da7a326c-f885-461d-95d9-6a22fccb5f6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Israel.
"They certainly weren't paid to be there," Gottlieb said, referring to the SLIC launch. "Fetterman, we just visited him in his office to tell him thank you for standing up and being a voice of reason."
The Department of Justice did not respond to a question about whether Terrell was at the event in an official capacity. Fetterman's office also did not respond to a request for comment.
The SLIC launch invitation was sent in a mass email to legislators and CC'd to two Israeli foreign ministry officials: Lior Haiat, who hosted 50 States One Israel as the deputy director for North American affairs, and Sawsan Hasson, a spokesperson for the embassy in Washington. Prospective attendees were invited "to be linked to the ministry of foreign affairs so we can reserve your spot," and were offered free airfare and accommodation in Washington for the inaugural event.
"That money came from--I don't know the exact source, from the Israeli government," Gottlieb told Drop Site. "Nobody was paid directly. The airfare and hotel was covered."
It's not unheard of for an American nonprofit to work on political advocacy with foreign officials--but it is controversial. The Foreign Agent Registration Act, a law notorious for its[ vagueness](https://substack.com/redirect/2a0730cc-b547-4cb0-b10e-7230491ec99c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and[ selective enforcement](https://substack.com/redirect/3fdb62a0-e0d6-47e1-b424-d86a4aeae1c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), requires Americans to disclose political activities "directly or indirectly supervised, directed, controlled, financed, or subsidized in whole or in major part" by a foreign patron.
Last year, a Sikh temple filed a[ FARA complaint](https://substack.com/redirect/60c643f6-9dba-4eda-b1fa-a365fbfa615c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against the Hindu American Foundation for coordinating political events with the Indian embassy and lobbying for pro-India policies. (The foundation, which has not been charged with FARA violations, "[categorically rejects](https://substack.com/redirect/85f77ddb-c40c-4a80-8926-9540015db74d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" that it acts on behalf of the government of India.)
Israeli officials discussed using the nonprofit system to avoid FARA disclosure, a leaked 2018 memo[ reported](https://substack.com/redirect/98a9092d-58c8-479a-9c7a-da65a682e0f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by The Guardian shows. The idea was to fund American partners indirectly through a nonprofit organization that would not trigger FARA requirements. A legal advisor for Israel's Ministry of Strategic Affairs suggested that "informal coordination mechanisms" such as "oral meetings" could give the ministry "means of supervision and management" over those American partners without a paper trail, according to The Guardian.
Creating SLIC "was at nobody's advice or suggestion other than my own," Gottlieb, who has represented parts of Broward County since 2018, told Drop Site.
While state legislators would seem to be distant from foreign policy issues, the Israeli government and its supporters have[ increasingly identified](https://substack.com/redirect/704fb176-1fae-4fb7-9f59-7d2dbafe6838?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) them as a battleground against the Palestinian boycott movement. At the 50 States One Israel conference, Foreign Minister Gideon Saar[ told](https://substack.com/redirect/eb7550ad-b366-4472-b8d9-37728e623e51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the crowd that they should be promoting antiboycott laws. A leaked Israeli justice ministry strategy memo from 2019, previously[ reported](https://substack.com/redirect/c3cb4889-4ae7-47d1-9d45-d1445a3abd30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Reason Magazine, suggested that state-level antiboycott activism would also "promote a trend of messaging and momentum to Israel's benefit."
Florida has been a major hotspot for state-level pro-Israel activism. It was [one of the first states](https://substack.com/redirect/a2919a7a-9bc4-46ac-9e0d-5326fbbd1858?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to ban boycotting Israel in 2016. DeSantis came to office three years later promising to be "the most pro-Israel Governor in the nation." That year, he [traveled to Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/39318078-7e3f-486b-b2f4-ece722fbb301?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to sign a bill against antisemitism. Since then, he has also [mandated boycotts](https://substack.com/redirect/1a901149-8d28-4b07-8068-f57882690b3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Iran, [attempted to ban](https://substack.com/redirect/7f029812-214f-4488-b9f3-729cec45795d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Students for Justice in Palestine, and created a [state terrorist watchlist](https://substack.com/redirect/14c018ef-e058-418e-8999-5b3ec2f1e54d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Because it is also one of the most transparent states in the country--the Sunshine Law is [one of the few](https://substack.com/redirect/aa8e372a-d57e-4a6c-887d-87894f32dbe7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) state-level public records laws that includes legislators' email inboxes--Florida provides a unique look into the Israeli government's direct involvement in U.S. politics.
For example, during May 2023 clashes in the Palestinian territories, Israeli foreign ministry official Kennedy Starnes[ wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/7e4ef8f0-e4c9-4472-bafd-ac2330b20f8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Zoraida Druckman, an aide to then-Florida State Senate Minority Leader Lauren Book, a Democrat. Starnes asked Druckman to "publish support statements on Social Media" for the Israeli war effort, and attached an "unclassified report" full of Israeli talking points. Book[ tweeted](https://substack.com/redirect/a870c10c-8bce-484b-85a7-c32bede1b022?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a pro-Israel statement an hour later, and Druckman sent a link to Starnes.
Druckman, who now works for a Republican state qsenator, did not respond to a request for comment.
Gottlieb himself was in contact with the Israeli foreign ministry for several years. In an email thread from October 23, 2023, he[ wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/8f2bc7dc-435d-48bb-9e67-8104d4ec2bd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Starnes that "the general consul and I discussed our working together towards an Israel day at the Capitol." That event came to fruition--and ended up being much more than a cultural celebration.
On February 29, 2024, Israeli Consul General Maor Elbaz-Starinsky[ presented state legislators](https://substack.com/redirect/1044ad19-138f-4084-ad4c-45bf25a48582?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with an Israeli flag as they[ listened to survivors](https://substack.com/redirect/b701cf52-c030-43ef-a720-f4d6f46fd981?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the October 2023 attacks on Israel and[ signed into law](https://substack.com/redirect/b788f656-b6aa-4504-98aa-83f2b44f9695?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the controversial[ IHRA definition](https://substack.com/redirect/356f1c6b-073c-4dae-8668-8a818bf12af0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of antisemitism. (The IHRA definition has been used to[ suppress Palestinian activism](https://substack.com/redirect/532311a8-f345-4ece-8d89-6e41f7710032?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) around the world, and its own author has stated that he "[never intended](https://substack.com/redirect/356f1c6b-073c-4dae-8668-8a818bf12af0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" it to be a "hate speech code.") Gottlieb and Elbaz-Starinsky[ stood on stage](https://substack.com/redirect/b788f656-b6aa-4504-98aa-83f2b44f9695?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) looking serious next to then-state legislator Randy Fine, who was grinning ear-to-ear.
Fine, now a Republican congressman, has gained[ national notoriety](https://substack.com/redirect/49033700-2fe4-460e-9695-19ea56a45ddd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for a string of anti-Muslim and anti-Palestinian comments over the past year, stating that "mainstream Muslims have declared war on us" and Palestinians should "[starve away](https://substack.com/redirect/1d497e0d-33d7-4225-961e-78b2c233e973?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." But even as a state legislator, Fine's views were clear. In 2021, he called Palestinians "[animals](https://substack.com/redirect/91b440d5-ae96-48b6-b3c9-ad7017f282e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" and replied to a photo of a dead Palestinian baby on social media with "[Thanks for the pic!](https://substack.com/redirect/d5ad224e-0efe-4354-bd63-7d9287fd80ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"
Like his earlier Israel Day event, Gottlieb presents SLIC as a scrupulously bipartisan organization. "There's nothing nefarious about it," Gottlieb told Drop Site. "It's really just meant to help improve relationships with each of the 50 states and Israel, because I do think that there is a symbiotic relationship that all can benefit from."

Friend,

I recently joined the _What It Takes_ podcast to discuss my journey to Congress and how I'm standing up for working people.

We covered a lot, so here's a summary:

It was never in my plan to run for Congress. I worked in politics behind the scenes – in labor communities, for Governor JB Pritzker passing a $15 minimum wage, and in the White House implementing the American Rescue Plan.

In 2022, I got a feeling I couldn't shake. Central and Southern Illinois deserved better – from the steel mills to soybean fields and everywhere in between. I decided to run, and I flipped IL-13 from red to blue.

Now, I'm in Congress doing things differently – _getting results as a workhorse, not a showhorse_ – and prioritizing working people who are often left behind.

**I'm fighting against corruption and dark money in our politics. I'm calling out ICE. I'm working across the aisle. Above all, I'm getting results for working families.**

| Peter,

We have one goal this November: **Flip the House blue** so that we’re not just surviving the end of a Trump administration, but actively working against it.

I looked up the average cost to repair a washing machine in the United States.
It can run about $200. That is outrageous.
As a mechanic, that grinds my gears.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
But as a mom, it pisses me off.
Because this is bigger than a broken washing machine.
Families are being forced to pay more and more just to get through the week, while big corporations keep finding new ways to nickel-and-dime us.
When you buy something, you should own it. You should be able to fix it. You should be able to take it to the local repair shop down the road, instead of being forced back to a corporation that wants to bleed you dry.
That is why I am fighting for the Right to Repair.
And that is exactly the difference in this race.
My MAGA opponent is not fighting for the mom staring down a $200 washing machine repair bill and the pile of clothes building up. He is not fighting for the small repair shop trying to keep its doors open. He is not fighting for the dad, uncle, neighbor, or young mechanic who knows how to fix the problem but cannot get help their family because corporations own the parts and the manual.
My opponent is standing with the corporations that make everyday life more expensive.
I am standing with you.
I’m not going to ask you to chip in the cost of repairing a washing machine, because we all know that’s too damn high. But can you chip in just $3? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]

$3 to stand up for small repair shops, tradespeople, and families getting squeezed.
$3 to fight for truly affordable child care, because working parents deserve more than impossible choices.
Together, we can build a country where regular people can fix what they own, afford to raise a family, and aren’t nickel-and-dimed by corporations that already have enough.
Thank you for standing with me in this fight.
Marie

| | Peter,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **

We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **

_But now, Peter, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

Texas passed some of the strictest abortion laws in the country and our maternal mortality rate has climbed 33 percent since 2019, while the national rate dropped by 7.5 percent. The Texas Republican Party platform now goes after IVF, the treatment families rely on to have children in the first place. body:
Hi All,

Thank you so much to all those who were able to come out this last Sunday!
I speak for the whole team when I say we had a wonderful time catching up
with you, the volunteers that made the Primary victory happen! We look
forward to seeing you all more as we prepare for the general in November!

Marni would also like to invite you out to join us this *Saturday, July
18th, for San Diego Pride!* The biggest party in San Diego County! The
Campaign will be marching in the Parade and we'd love to have you with us
as we show up strong for the community! There'll be snacks, drinks, and *free
official Marni von Wilpert T-shirts* for those who RSVP! Here is the link

*Canvass with Marni for CD-48 - San Marcos*

body:
My office gets frequent calls from residents in the 13th congressional district because their current member of Congress is unresponsive.
#
Peter,
The incumbent in the congressional district right next to mine is a multi-millionaire who has spent $17 million of his own money to bankroll his campaigns, while using your tax dollars on ads to promote himself.
He voted to give ICE access to our private information while publicly thanking ICE as they terrorize our communities.
He’s also backed by AIPAC’s network of super PACs and has consistently voted to send more bombs to Israel’s genocidal military with our tax dollars. And because of his own stock in cryptocurrency, he was one of only two Democrats who voted with Republicans to help crypto billionaires get even richer.
Now, as ballots begin mailing to voters across the state, this self-financed multi-millionaire incumbent is up with TV ads. We need to counter his millions with grassroots power.
**Luckily, there’s someone running to replace him: my friend Donavan McKinney, a working-class democratic socialist.**
Donavan has organized workers for living wages with the SEIU. In the State House, he secured $600 million to get lead out of our water and millions for public schools and community violence intervention, while leading fights to lower the cost of living and expand workers’ rights.
We need Donavan McKinney to represent the 13th congressional district, which is one of the poorest in the country. **I need him by my side in Congress to end poverty and build a government that works for the people, rather than billionaires and war profiteers.**
**[Split a donation to Donavan’s campaign and Justice Democrats today to help him overcome his opponent’s corporate PAC money. Sixty-three percent of voters in the 13th district vote by mail, and ballots are being mailed to voters right now.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260713-1-dm.itPn6f&refcode=em20260713-38021&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=2&akid=38021%2E1203867%2E3LmrwI)**
**[Contribute $10](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260713-1-dm.itPn6f&refcode=em20260713-38021&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=21&akid=38021%2E1203867%2E3LmrwI)**
Thank you so much. Your support is powerful as we work together to build a government for the people.
Right now, most of my coworkers in Congress are millionaires and take money from AIPAC, along with other billionaire-backed PACs.
But I know that together we can send the champions we deserve to represent us in Washington, DC... people like Donavan McKinney who aren’t scared to dream—and fight for—a vision big enough to match the scale of our crises.
With you in the fight for better,
Rashida

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20260713-38021-footer&t=22&refcode2=38021_1203867_3LmrwI&akid=38021%2E1203867%2E3LmrwI)**

Peter,

It's been over a year since President Trump pardoned us J6 prisoners.

But even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers...

**Some are homeless to this day. Some can 't get a job because of the time they've spent in jail. Many are struggling to return to some semblance of a normal life.**

They have been separated from their families for years. They have had their rights stripped from them. They can't vote. They can't own a firearm.

Not only are these men and women patriots, but they come from all walks of life -- law enforcement, veterans, white-collar professionals, blue-collar workers, and all races and religions.

_And they were hunted down in a political persecution that denied them their constitutional rights. _

So what comes next for J6ers?

But even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers... Some are homeless to this day. Some can 't get a job because of the time they've spent in jail. Many are struggling to return to some semblance of a normal life. They have been separated from their families for years. They have had their rights stripped from them. They can't vote. They can't own a firearm. Not only are these men and women patriots, but they come from all walks of life -- law enforcement, veterans, white-collar professionals, blue-collar workers, and all races and religions. And they were hunted down in a political persecution that denied them their constitutional rights. So what comes next for J6ers? There are nearly 1,600 Americans who need to rebuild their lives. We are committed to providing comprehensive, practical support to ensure that each individual can rebuild their life with dignity, hope, and purpose. Our mission is deeply rooted in the conviction that legal forgiveness is only the beginning. We want to give J6ers the support to fully reintegrate into their communities with the strength to start anew. Surprisingly, there are very few resources for people who are released from prison, particularly if they are conservative or America First activists. While some J6ers come from families with means, most do not. We were founded to "stand in the gap" for those in prison and those navigating life after incarceration. We want them to know that they are not forgotten. This begins by providing housing and vehicles, counseling, and confidential peer support; the tools needed for healing and reintegration. The J6ers are our neighbors. They are sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, mothers and fathers. It is up to us to ensure that they have the resources needed to rebuild their lives and reclaim their dignity. For years, Josh Shapiro has carefully cultivated an image as a strong, pragmatic leader.

| | | | | | This isn’t an isolated example.
Time and again, Josh Shapiro has shown that when the political pressure rises, he folds.
He once supported school choice, but when the teachers’ unions pushed back, he abandoned Pennsylvania families. Today, our Commonwealth ranks near the bottom nationally in education, and nearly 70% of Pennsylvania eighth graders cannot read at grade level. body:
| | | Peter, Someone is getting rich from the AI boom. **But it isn't the people watching their utility bills climb while Big Tech builds another massive data center.** Across the country, Big Tech companies are investing billions to expand the AI industry. They're building massive data centers that consume enormous amounts of electricity and water, put new pressure on local communities, and leave working families paying more while Silicon Valley billionaires reap the rewards. And the same corporations and billionaires profiting from AI are spending millions to influence elections, fight stronger oversight of the AI industry, and avoid paying their fair share in taxes. **That's why we want to hear directly from you.** [**Will you take a minute to complete our July WFP Supporter Survey and tell us how the AI boom and the changing economy are affecting you and your community?**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRI-9MMp9XRImnsQejMVe-q1p2FQPATIL7m7EmhwcQNaWAdIsvxAdreFCM3-6xgKqeon5NwXi6PFU9Au1Ik3Co5gtaaS2CTiow7WrzlrunWgGhoE9fDblaUbP_B2XEQCIPEJd6iMt9W-oVS4vtuBn-xEe_c4VrM0aKLj48DDC71ZaOgKQg4PtMK-1unqY8nG24NmiO9MsVNI5tNDnBniVLX74-vaZ05h5pre2RzwAm6LTEYCJcA7zgaCpUaj7hE4wqn3fcOMFSQ4xHYPywFg2aund-1sfq0lGE84pDuWuOQicQ/4sa/cwhiXqcATfe4CZ0rsfZKrw/h0/h001.83cmhxKUHRKWfS4SLhE2h1d4hrHw_MsU72K00DyOfJU) **[Take the WFP Supporter Survey »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRI-9MMp9XRImnsQejMVe-q1p2FQPATIL7m7EmhwcQNaWAdIsvxAdreFCM3-6xgKqeon5NwXi6PFU9Au1Ik3Co5gqeTKHo30gHQWygBIxSx_mBmwF9plsUMsXjj-9XKR2jyMBwl8TTv7Bao_uMCwhRK0_b8A3NDGZkIY0mg3Xl8bOBV7HpKZGZNpzS0Jfj1Kyov-M3oWpp4Cs_Z7MbXevOtGfbGL0bQEQVp3TY1euA5g2uQqx8g-VadriCU5Ei9dRzZJtuayaU_W-PRmPXkVGLhCcrnbLvpI79zKkgqP2K-2iQ/4sa/cwhiXqcATfe4CZ0rsfZKrw/h1/h001.F9ntvupfX5U8EjZHfmVAvVpz9D_APvzznNB0zbh8Xq8)** **The rapid expansion of AI isn't just changing the technology we use, Peter.** It's reshaping our economy. Companies are using AI to cut jobs, restructure workplaces, and increase profits. And working people know what's at stake: **73%** of working-class voters are concerned AI will lead to job losses, and nearly **two-thirds** believe the government should protect jobs, wages, and economic security when corporations replace workers with AI. Meanwhile, the billionaires and tech giants profiting from AI are _also_ spending millions to influence the 2026 midterm elections and fight the safeguards that working families want.1 The two largest AI super PACs raised more than $200 million to help elect candidates who will stand with Big Tech over working families.2 [**That's why we're asking you to take our July WFP Supporter Survey today.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRI-9MMp9XRImnsQejMVe-q1p2FQPATIL7m7EmhwcQNaWAdIsvxAdreFCM3-6xgKqeon5NwXi6PFU9Au1Ik3Co5gG5YLR0kQrMhTpzvHn07SAwlUkhjsiSpzM6sfFexi2bNA736iGBQTUhHwZ99wW74cyyiN9at7wg0ogiNeNF--V6JTNkR1_LMS7z1GqyAbVyD-Dpe5rhB6HhaiwefEAQr-lbW6AMy529lG71Qg0bEKEgFmJfgRIt5eGuyX_BctFJ9Ju-ZHuerVmFgyPLpIYQx9EUmtvA-s7jXx0Ui7kBLUoQ/4sa/cwhiXqcATfe4CZ0rsfZKrw/h2/h001.QYf4o_hRZFR_1hDyFgF78sc8YNLeHlyK38ngUzekj5U) **Your responses will help shape our organizing, advocacy, and campaigns to win real oversight of the AI industry, protect jobs, keep costs down, and hold powerful corporations accountable for the impact AI is already having on our communities.** **[Take the WFP Supporter Survey »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRI-9MMp9XRImnsQejMVe-q1p2FQPATIL7m7EmhwcQNaWAdIsvxAdreFCM3-6xgKqeon5NwXi6PFU9Au1Ik3Co5grgyQf9H6wFgNptQE0GIouPOx9t8iB4DsTF6yrdRkD4IcCkWAH5m1iV-8ZqQcJbnd85R6BASf8YhAZkIeU20NOyWkkaD6P3952NpydYwV7i8prHl0CgV7zL6XnZUtX6kSDyYOwg283rGx5aX-_pReLZ-Ge6Un9wYTwumLP7J1-vymMbwdnwAQENyeVmw-o05aXWRKmGQgHNUUYp1yqeFC2g/4sa/cwhiXqcATfe4CZ0rsfZKrw/h3/h001.LN0J2okYoTxaTj2b3KqTkBco-PSP-5JWwnAoXeBxlf0)** In solidarity, WFP Digital Team Sources: 1\. clean_body: | | | Peter, Someone is getting rich from the AI boom. But it isn't the people watching their utility bills climb while Big Tech builds another massive data center. Across the country, Big Tech companies are investing billions to expand the AI industry. They're building massive data centers that consume enormous amounts of electricity and water, put new pressure on local communities, and leave working families paying more while Silicon Valley billionaires reap the rewards. And the same corporations and billionaires profiting from AI are spending millions to influence elections, fight stronger oversight of the AI industry, and avoid paying their fair share in taxes. That's why we want to hear directly from you. The rapid expansion of AI isn't just changing the technology we use, Peter. It's reshaping our economy. Companies are using AI to cut jobs, restructure workplaces, and increase profits. And working people know what's at stake: 73% of working-class voters are concerned AI will lead to job losses, and nearly two-thirds believe the government should protect jobs, wages, and economic security when corporations replace workers with AI. Meanwhile, the billionaires and tech giants profiting from AI are also spending millions to influence the 2026 midterm elections and fight the safeguards that working families want.1 The two largest AI super PACs raised more than $200 million to help elect candidates who will stand with Big Tech over working families.2 Your responses will help shape our organizing, advocacy, and campaigns to win real oversight of the AI industry, protect jobs, keep costs down, and hold powerful corporations accountable for the impact AI is already having on our communities. In solidarity, WFP Digital Team Sources: 1\. , NPR , June 24, 2026. 2\. , CNBC , July 9, 2026. Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. Kansas is a red state where abortion is legal.
In 2019 the Kansas Supreme Court ruled to recognize the right to abortion in the state's Constitution, in 2022 MAGA pushed a ballot measure to overturn this but in a move that shocked the nation voters rejected it.
Now, on August 4th, 2026, in Kansas's upcoming statewide primary election, MAGA has what could be their last chance to criminalize abortion here.

On the ballot for Kansas's upcoming election is an obscure measure that will decide whether the state should elect its state's supreme court judges, or if they should stick with the status quo where the governor appoints justices to the court.
A Democrat has controlled the Kansas Governor's office since 2019 and experts believe Democrats have a strong shot at capturing it again this November. As such we've had control over this supreme court's nomination process for longer than half a decade.
MAGA knows they may never win the Governor's office again so they hope to change the system and elect judges as opposed to appointing them. Under their ballot measure, judicial elections will be presided over by the GOP controlled Kansas legislature -- this way they will be able to rig them and ensure their candidates win.
A win for MAGA on this critical ballot issue could mean that Kansans could be stripped of their right to abortion by the end of 2027.
Defend our Courts is one of the only organizations actively fighting to ensure Democrats retain control over key state supreme courts across the nation. We need your help.

body:
Parades in Johnson & Cheney, Behind the Scenes, and Door-knocking!

| | | | | [|

---
| |
# Behind the Scenes: On Set with the Campaign Team
---
| | _Click on the picture below for a video of Team Baumgartner in action!_
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/z1eGEqkMgza?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
| | Running for Congress means spending a lot of time meeting with families, business owners, farmers, and community leaders across Eastern Washington. But recently, we traded the campaign trail for the camera to film the commercials that help share our message with voters throughout the district.
While the final product may only last 30 seconds, a lot of work goes into bringing it to life. From setting up each shot to making sure every detail is just right, I'm grateful for the dedicated team working behind the scenes. I especially appreciate their patience as they endured my many takes before we finally got the right one!

---
|
---
| |
# Doorsteps & Dialogue in Spokane
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/LSjP4zJnTtP?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
| | There’s no better way to connect with our community than by knocking on doors and having conversations with the people we’re working to serve. Most recently, my team and I traveled to Spokane's South Hill, where we spent the afternoon visiting with neighbors and hearing firsthand about the issues that matter most to them.
I always appreciate the chance to listen, answer questions, and learn from the people who call Eastern Washington home. Thank you to everyone who welcomed us at their doorstep and shared their thoughts with us. I'm especially grateful to our incredible campaign team and volunteers who dedicate their time and energy to reaching voters across the district. Every conversation reminds me why I'm committed to fighting for the values and priorities of Washington's Fifth District.
---
|
---
| |
# Stars, Stripes, & 60 years of the Johnson parade!
---
| | I had a wonderful time celebrating America’s 250th birthday with my family at the Johnson Independence Day Parade on the beautiful Palouse! It was a great opportunity to come together to celebrate the freedoms we cherish. I’ve been attending the Johnson parade since my childhood, and it was especially fun to be there for the 60th year since it first got started by local farming families in this small town.
---
|
---
| |
From high-fiving the crowds along the parade route to visiting with community members, I really enjoyed the chance to connect with the people who make our district such a great place to call home.
A special thank you to everyone who came out to celebrate with us and to the incredible volunteers who helped represent our campaign - not least my amazing mom Dee, and our eldest son who got to be the ever-popular “Baumgartner basketball hoop”. I'm grateful for the warm welcome and look forward to many more opportunities to celebrate with communities across the Fifth District!
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
# Cheney Parade Highlights
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | | |

---
Team Baumgartner had a great time at the Cheney Parade last weekend! The streets were packed with families and friends enjoying a beautiful summer day together, and it was a pleasure to be part of the celebration.

We rolled through town with two decorated vehicles, an outstanding group of volunteers, and enough candy to keep kids smiling long after the parade ended! It was a great opportunity to catch up with familiar faces, meet new ones, and celebrate the Cheney community.

Thank you Kelly, John, and Jane for donating your time and vehicles to make this parade a success.

At its core, this is about what kind of government we deserve — one that exists to improve our lives,not make them worse. Where affordable healthcare and housing take priority over fancy ballrooms and backroom deals to further enrich wealthy allies. This is why I'm leading the charge to end the corruption in Washington. # **[Apple drops bombshell lawsuit on OpenAI for brazen trade secret raids](https://substack.com/redirect/fcb13067-89ca-4d40-ac1f-0d27bde41f20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Apple just filed a 41-page complaint accusing OpenAI of orchestrating a full-on raid on its employees and network storage, complete with smug texts like "LOL, I found out I can access the [network storage], so funny." This isn't friendly rivalry it's straight corporate espionage in the AI gold rush. OpenAI denies wanting anyone's secrets, but the details scream desperation.
• **Winners?** Apple lawyers and IP hawks locking down the castle while sending a chill through every poacher in Silicon Valley.
• **Losers?** OpenAI staring down legal bills and talent-war fallout that could slow their rollout.
• **Next?** Discovery turns ugly, more dirt spills, and either a fat settlement or this drags into a nasty precedent for every AI shop.
This lawsuit proves one thing: in AI, the real moat isn't models it's who owns the secrets and who's willing to steal them. Apple's fighting like the predator it is while OpenAI learns the hard way that shortcuts cost real money. Smart money sides with the fortress builders. The rest get torched.

Earnings week hits and financials are rotating stronger while tech flattens out. XLF (State Street's Financial Select ETF)**** sits at 15.5 times forward earnings cheaper than last year and implied correlation is historically low, making those August $56 calls dirt cheap at a Buck. This is the levered play on real growth, not AI fairy tales.
• **Winners?** Bank shareholders and anyone grabbing XLF calls for six weeks of pure earnings juice.
• **Losers?** Tech bros who overpaid for narrative while missing the nominal GDP haystack.
• **Next?** Earnings beat, forecasts get marked up, and the rotation from pure AI into financials accelerates hard.
The anomaly is your cue. Banks don't need to pick winners in the AI cage match, they win if America keeps growing. Cheap options, real leverage, real profits. Load the boat before the herd wakes up and this trade prints.

# **[Micron locks in AI memory dominance with $22 billion in ironclad customer deals](https://substack.com/redirect/2aeabe64-3b39-4378-9b5d-0df0856bcdfa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Exactly as I nailed it in **["Wall Street crowns Micron the next Nvidia,"](https://substack.com/redirect/636d71a7-4715-429c-ae5b-92a72163ea6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** the memory crunch is minting billionaires. Now Micron drops $22 billion in take-or-pay commitments across 16 customers shifting risk, locking supply through 2027 and beyond. Revenue already at $41.46 billion. RAMageddon is here and profitable as hell.
• **Winners?** Micron shareholders and the memory kings printing money while hyperscalers secure their fix.
• **Losers?** Device makers getting price-gouged and any competitor still scrambling for capacity.
• **Next?** Pricing power holds, Q4 guidance crushes expectations, and the stock gaps higher again.
My call is playing out daily. AI needs memory like cars need gas and Micron owns the pump. These contracts de-risk the cyclical bullshit and turn thirst into locked-in cash flow. Buy every dip this is still the next Nvidia play. Weak hands will regret sitting out.

# **[Trump accounts app promises to turn your kid into a millionaire by 45, maybe, maybe not, but they wont be poor thats for sure](https://substack.com/redirect/2aeabe64-3b39-4378-9b5d-0df0856bcdfa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
The new Trump Accounts launch with a $1,000 Treasury seed plus up to $5,000 a year in after-tax cash, and the app spits out millionaire-by-45 projections assuming 10% S&P returns forever. Experts already warn the realistic number is closer to 6.3% but who leaves that on the table? Tax-advantaged kid IRAs for babies born 2025-2028 is pure wealth-transfer rocket fuel, just go check the tape on the S&P the last 18 years.
• **Winners?** Families maxing the accounts and every advisor steering clients into this new tax shelter.
• **Losers?** Skeptics who miss the compounding window and anyone still ignoring the kid-wealth play.
• **Next?** This is capitalism handing parents a cheat code. The projections are optimistic but the structure is bulletproof.
Get your kid in early, compound tax-free, and watch the next generation of millionaires roll out. The rest can keep complaining while smart money builds dynasties.

# **[Meta stock turns positive on the year on data center plans and cheap ai pricing](https://substack.com/redirect/2aeabe64-3b39-4378-9b5d-0df0856bcdfa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Meta shares jumped 6% to turn positive YTD after Zuckerberg floated renting out AI compute power and dropped the Muse Spark 1.1 model priced at $1.25 per million input tokens slashing competitors like OpenAI and Anthropic. New Canada data center and plans to sell capacity like a "neocloud." Finally some real revenue outside ads!
• **Winners?** Meta shareholders watching the AI spend finally pay rent and developers flocking to the cheap model.
• **Losers?** Overpriced frontier labs getting undercut on token pricing. This is going to be a theme in the coming weeks and months.
• **Next?** More data-center leasing deals, Spark adoption spikes, and the stock keeps climbing as capex starts delivering.
Zuck finally stopped burning cash like a drunk sailor and started charging rent. This is how you turn AI capex into profit instead of just another black hole. Meta's playbook just got smarter, load up before the next leg.

# **[Big banks poised to report record revenue from SpaceX IPO fees and Iran war volatility](https://substack.com/redirect/2aeabe64-3b39-4378-9b5d-0df0856bcdfa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
JPM, Goldman, BofA and the rest report Tuesday and the Street expects investment banking up 26%, trading up 14%, all fueled by the SpaceX IPO fees Goldman and Morgan Stanley gorged on plus Iran-war volatility whipping oil, rates and currencies. Exactly as predicted when we watched SpaceX raise $85.7 billion and banks pocket the soft dollars.
• **Winners?** JPM, GS, BAC shareholders and anyone long financials riding the IPO and volatility wave.
• **Losers?** Anyone still short banks betting on rate cuts that never came.
• **Next?** Earnings crush estimates, forecasts get upgraded, and financials extend their two-year outperformance streak.
This is the sweet spot I've been screaming about: Wall Street fees plus Main Street lending all firing at once. SpaceX and Iran just handed banks a blank check. Buy the names, ride the momentum, weak hands who missed this rotation are already toast.

# **[Meta pours 50 billion into Louisiana data center supercluster amid AI arms race](https://substack.com/redirect/2aeabe64-3b39-4378-9b5d-0df0856bcdfa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Two for Meta today, Zuck just bumped his Louisiana Hyperion project to $50 billion for a 5 GW AI supercluster up from the original $10 billion plan thanks to fat state tax breaks and energy deals. Local contracts already at $1.6 billion. This is hyperscalers racing to own the compute while states bid like it's Black Friday.
• **Winners?** Meta shareholders finally seeing Zuck's capex turn into moat and Louisiana getting the jobs and infrastructure windfall.
• **Losers?** States that didn't offer the sweetheart deals and any rival still behind on power and land.
• **Next?** More expansion announcements, Meta starts leasing excess capacity, and the stock keeps ripping on visible returns.
Zuck is finally playing chess while frontier players (OpenAI and Anthropic) plays checkers with debt and IOU's. $50 billion is real money and real infrastructure, tax incentives just made it cheaper for sure but this is how you win the AI war: build bigger, faster, and let state government subsidize it because they want it in their backyard. Another reason to load Meta.

# We Just Cut Every Price by 25%
### The Bastille Day Sale: one week, every plan, through Sunday, July 19.

---|---|---
**On July 14, 1789, ordinary Parisians got tired of being ruled by people who inherited everything, earned nothing, and taxed bread while throwing parties at Versailles. So they walked up to the fortress that symbolized all of it --and took it.**
**Sound familiar?**
America in 2026 has its own aristocracy. They have names. They have rockets. They have a Supreme Court wing they bought at auction and a media ecosystem that calls all of it freedom. The predator class doesn't wear powdered wigs--they wear fleece vests and fund super PACs--but the arrangement is the same one Paris got sick of 237 years ago: they take everything, and we're supposed to say thank you.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.5-ig7ozvWdNxtbjnSrpLOyQFc_dxL6MJdJntu5VllD8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=206897532)
Blue Amp exists for one reason: Democrats must be at least as loud with the truth as Republicans are with lies. Every subscription funds that fight--no billionaire owner, no hedge fund, no corporate line to toe. Just us. And you.
So this week, we're lowering the drawbridge.
[From now through Sunday, July 19, every Blue Amp subscription is 25% off. Monthly $12 -> $9. Annual $60 -> $45. Everything.](https://substack.com/redirect/18b2a6ce-c54d-46bf-a775-b82af599e974?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Here's what's inside the gates: the weekly Zoom Q&A with me--ask anything, and I mean anything; the private subscriber chat, where the sharpest political conversation on Substack happens daily; and full access to every column, every stream, and a community of thousands funding independent progressive media.
[Storm The Gates! 25% Off](https://substack.com/redirect/18b2a6ce-c54d-46bf-a775-b82af599e974?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Bastille held exactly seven prisoners the day it fell. The point was never the prisoners. The point was proving that the people who thought they were untouchable--weren't.
That's the whole job. Come do it with us.
-- Cliff
#### P.S. Already subscribed? First: _thank you._
#### Second: gift subscriptions are the drawbridge for a friend.
#### Send one this week.
[Give a gift subscription](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.5-ig7ozvWdNxtbjnSrpLOyQFc_dxL6MJdJntu5VllD8?&gift=true)

Fellow American, it's Don Jr. I wanted to take a moment to **express my heartfelt gratitude** for **your unwavering support**. My father and I know that this fight **isn't possible without patriots like you** who are willing to stand up for what's right.

| **President Donald J. Trump** and the **Republican National Committee** have announced the details for the **2026 Republican Mid-term National Convention** in **Dallas, TX, September 9 and 10.**

This is the first Mid-term National Convention in Republican Party history. President Trump believes it is important for winning Congressional elections and other elections this November. And he’s said on the record that **this Convention will be a** **“once-in-a-lifetime experience.”**

This Mid-term Convention will be different than standard presidential-election year conventions. The Republican National Committee has delegated selection of attendees to the various State Parties. But **the timeline to make these selections is tight** : State Parties have until **July 15** to submit their attendee lists to the RNC.

For best-possible speed and fairness, the WAGOP is distributing most of its convention tickets through **a** **modified Dutch auction** (also known as a **“sealed-bid, descending price”** auction). Bids start at $125 but can go as high as each bidder chooses. Republicans interested in attending the 2026 Mid-term Convention, can make a non-refundable bid at this link: [Support - Washington State Republican Party (WAGOP).](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=31307&L=15988&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS93YWdvcC8yYmE4ZjI2Ni1iNzk1LTQ4ZTgtYjQ4MS05ZGZkNzI4MWRhYTg/dXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01UUXhOVGcxTWpRJTNE&hash=e8323a4cb98bc6eb74fdb94cf08ad9c307cab37533493c82eb78d73e7f5b408f)

WAGOP will distribute tickets based on **bids received by 6 p.m. on Tuesday evening, July 14**. Bidders can place multiple bids, if they wish—but **all bids are non-refundable**.

NOTE: These tickets admit individuals to the 2026 Republican Mid-term National Convention. **They do NOT include travel or accommodations** in Dallas—and the RNC is requiring attendees to stay at designated Mid-term Convention hotels in Dallas. More details on those accommodations will be available after the attendee lists from each state are finalized.
